a: Tana: vachatzi chatzi chetzyah letamme tumeat ochalin. vetanna didan may tama la tane tumeat ochalin? mishshum dela shavu shiurayyhu lahadade.
Detanya: kamma shiur chatzi feras? shete vetzim chaser kima, divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi yose omer: shete vetzim sochakot. shier rabbi, shete vetzim vaod. kamma vaod? echad meesrim babbetza.
Veillu gabbe tumeat ochalin tanya: rabbi natan verabbi dosa amru: kevetza sheamru kamoha vechiklippatah, vachachamim omrim: kamoha belo kelippatah.
Amar rafram bar pappa amar rav chisda: zo divre rabbi yehuda verabbi yose. aval chachamim omrim: kevetza umechetza sochakot. uman chachamim — rabbi yochanan ben beroka.
Peshita! sochakot ata leashmoinan.
Ki ata rav dimi, amar: shigger bonyos lerabbi modya dekondes demin neusa, veshier rabbi matan usheva esre bein.
Ha sea dehecha? i demidbarit, mea arbaim vearba havya!
Vei dirushalmit, mea shivim veshalosh havya!
Vei detzipporit, matayim vesheva havyayn!
Leolam detzipporit, ayyti challeta shedi alayyhu.
Challeta kamma havyayn? tamne, akkatti batzar leh!
Ella ayyti veodot derabbi shedi alayyhu.
I hachi, have leh tefe! kevan dela have kevetza, la chashev leh.
Tanu rabbanan sea yerushalmit yetera al midbarit shetut. veshel tzipporit yetera al yerushalmit shetut. nimtzet shel tzipporit yetera al midbarit shelish.
Shelish deman? illema shelish demidbarit, mikkedi shelish demidbarit kamma have — arbein utemanya, veillu udepa, shittin utelat.

Veella shelish dirushalmit: shelish dida kamma have — chamshin utemanya neche tilta, veillu udepa, shittin utelat. veella detzippori: shelish dida kamma have — shivin neche chada, veillu udepa, shishshim veshalosh.
Ella amar rabbi yirmeya, hachi kaamar: nimtzet sea shel tzippori yetera al midbarit karov lishlish shellah. ushelish shellah karov lemechetza demidbarit.
Matkef la ravina: midde "karov" "karov" katane? ella amar ravina, hachi kaamar: nimtzet shelish shel tzippori bivodayot shel rabbi yetera al mechetza shel midbarit shelish betza.
Tanu rabbanan: "reshit arisotechem",
b: Kede issotechem, vechamma issotechem? kede issat hammidbar. vechamma issat hammidbar?
Dichtiv: "vehaomer asirit haefa hu". mikkan amru, shiva revaim kemach vaod chayyevet bechalla, shehen shishsha shel yerushalmit, shehen chamishsha shel tzippori.
Mikkan amru: haochel kemidda zo — hare ze bari umevorach. yater al ken — raavtan. pachot mikkan — mekulekal bemeav.
Mishna anshe chatzer veanshe mirpeset sheshshachchu velo ervu, kol sheggavoah asara tefachim — lemirpeset. pachot mikkan — lechatzer.
Chuleyayt habbor vehassela, gevohim asara tefachim — lammirpeset, pachot mikkan — lechatzer.
Bamme devarim amurim — bismucha, aval bemufeleget — afillu gavoah asara tefachim — lechatzer. veezo hi semucha — kol sheenah rechoka arbaa tefachim.
Gemara peshita, laze befetach velaze befetach — hayeynu challon shebben shete chatzerot.
Laze bizrika velaze bizrika — hayeynu kotel shebben shete chatzerot. laze beshilshul velaze beshilshul — hayeynu charitz shebben shete chatzerot.
Laze befetach velaze bizrika — hayeynu derabba bar rav huna amar rav nachman. laze befetach velaze beshilshul — hayeynu derav shezvi amar rav nachman.
Laze beshilshul velaze bizrika, may?

Amar rav: shenehen asurin. ushemuel amar: notnin oto laze shebbeshilshul. shellaze tashmisho benachat, velaze tashmisho bekashe, vechol davar shettashmisho laze benachat velaze bekashe — notnim oto laze shettashmisho benachat.
Tenan: anshe chatzer veanshe mirpeset sheshshachchu velo ervu, kol sheggavoah asara tefachim — lammirpeset, pachot mikkan — lechatzer.
Ka salka datach, may mirpeset —

a: Bene aliyyay. umay karu la mirpeset? dekasalki bemirpeset, alma: kol laze beshilshul velaze bizrika — notnin oto laze shebbeshilshul!
Kidamar rav huna: leotan haddarim bammirpeset. hachi name: leotan haddarin bammirpeset.
I hachi, ema sefa: pachot mikkan — lechatzer. ammay? laze befetach velaze befetach hu!
May "lechatzer"? af lechatzer. ushenehen asurin.

Hachi name mistabbera, middekatane sefa: bamme devarim amurim bismucha. aval bemufeleget, afillu gavoah asara tefachim — lechatzer. may "lechatzer"? illema: lechatzer ushere, ammay? reshuta detarvayyhu hu!
Ella may "lechatzer" — af lechatzer, ushenehen asurin. hachi name: may "lechatzer" — af lechatzer, ushenehen asurin. shema minna.
Tenan: chuleyayt habbor vehassela shehen gevohin asara — lammirpeset, pachot mikkan — lechatzer. amar rav huna: leotan haddarim bammirpeset.
Tinach sela. bor may ikka lememar?
Amar rav yitzchak bereh derav yehuda: hacha bevor melea mayim askinan. veha chasra!
Kevan dechi malya sharya — ki chasra name sharya. adderabba, kevan dechi chasra asira — ki malya name asira.
Ella amar abbaye: hacha bevor melea perot askinan. veha chasri.
Betivla.
Dayka name dekatane dumeya desela. shema minna.
Ulema li lemitne bor ulema li lemitne sela? tzericha, dei ashmeinan sela — delekka lemigzar, aval bor — ligzor zimnin demalya perot metukkanin, tzericha.

Ta shema: anshe chatzer veanshe aliyyay sheshshachchu velo ervu — anshe chatzer mishtammeshin baasara hattachtonim, veanshe aliyyay mishtammeshin baasara haelyonim. ketzad? ziz yotze min hakkotel lematta measara — lechatzer, lemala measara — laaliyyay.
Ha devene bene — asur!
Amar rav nachman: hacha bechotel tisha asar askinan, veziz yotze mimmennu. lematta measara — laze befetach, velaze beshilshul. lemala measara — laze befetach, velaze bizrika.
b: Ta shema: shete gezuzetraot zo lemala mizzo. asu laelyona, velo asu lattachtona — shetehen asurot ad sheyyearvu!
Amar rav adda bar ahava: bevain bene tachtona derech elyona lemalloot.
Abbaye amar: kegon dekayyaymin betoch asara dahadade, vela mibbaya kaamar: la mibbaya asu lattachtona velo asu laelyona — daasiri, dechevan divgo asara dahadade kayyaymin — asran ahadade,

Ella afillu asu laelyona velo asu lattachtona, salka datach amena: kevan delaze benachat velaze bekashe — litteveh laze shettashmisho benachat, ka mashma lan: kevan divgo asara kayyaymin — asran ahadade.

Ki ha deamar rav nachman amar shemuel: gag hassamuch lirshut harabbim — tzarich sullam kavua lehattiro. sullam kavua in, sullam aray la. may tama? lav mishshum dechevan divtoch asara dahadade kayymi — asran ahadade!
Matkef la rav pappa: vedilma kesherabbim mechattefin alav, bechumeta vesudara.
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel:

a: Bor shebben shete chatzerot, mufeleget mikkotel ze arbaa umikkotel ze arbaa — ze motzi ziz kol shehu umemalle, veze motzi ziz kol shehu umemalle. verav yehuda dideh amar: afillu kanya.
Amar leh abbaye lerav yosef: ha derav yehuda dishmuel hi, dei derav, ha amar: en adam oser al chavero derech avir.
Vedishmuel mehecha? illema meha deamar rav nachman amar shemuel: gag hassamuch lirshut harabbim — tzarich sullam kavua lehattiro. dilma kidrav pappa!
Ella meha: ze motzi ziz kol shehu umemalle, veze motzi ziz kol shehu umemalle. tama deappek, ha la appek — amrinan: adam oser al chavero derech avir.
Uderav mehecha? illema meha: shete gezuzetraot zo lemala mizzo, asu mechitza laelyona velo asu mechitza lattachtona — shetehen asurot ad sheyyaarvu.
Veamar rav huna amar rav: lo shanu ella bismucha, aval bemufeleget arbaa — elyona mutteret vetachtona asura.
Dilma shane hacha, dechevan delaze bizrika veshilshul, velaze beshilshul lechodeh — kelaze bizrika velaze befetach dame.
Ella meha deamar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu amar rav: shene vattim veshalosh choravot benehem. ze mishtammesh bassamuch shello al yede zerika, vaze mishtammesh bassamuch shello al yede zerika,
b: Vehaemtzai — asur.
Yatev rav berona vekaamar leha shemata. amar leh rabbi eliezer bar be rav: amar rav hachi? amar leh: in. achvi li ushepizeh. achvi leh. ata lekammeh derav, amar leh: amar mar hachi? amar leh: in.
Amar leh, veha mar hu deamar: laze beshilshul velaze bizrika — shenehen asurin!
Amar leh: mi savrat dekayymi keshura? la — dekayymi kachatzuva.

Amar leh rav pappa lerava: lema shemuel let leh derav dimi. dechi ata rav dimi amar rabbi yochanan: makom sheen bo arba al arba — muttar livne reshut harabbim velivne reshut hayyachid lechattef alav, uvilvad shello yachalifu.
Hatam — reshuyot deorayyta, hacha — reshuyot derabbanan. vachachamim asu chizzuk ledivrehem yoter mishshel tora.
Amar leh ravina lerava: mi amar rav hachi? veha ittemar: shene vattim mishshene tzidde reshut harabbim, rabba bar rav huna amar rav: asur lizrok mizze laze, ushemuel amar: muttar lizrok mizze laze!
Amar leh: lav mi okemna demiddele chad umittatte chad, zimnin demiggandar venafel, veate leetoye.
Mishna hannoten et eruvo bevet shaar, achsadra umirpeset — eno eruv. vehaddar sham — eno oser alav.
Bet hatteven uvet habbakar uvet haetzim uvet haotzarot — hare ze eruv, vehaddar sham — oser. rabbi yehuda omer: im yesh sham tefisat yad shel baal habbayit — eno oser.

Gemara amar rav yehuda bereh derav shemuel bar shilat: kol makom sheamru haddar sham eno oser — hannoten et eruvo eno eruv, chutz mibbet shaar deyachid. vechol makom sheamru chachamim en mannichin bo eruv — mannichin bo shittuf, chutz meavir mavoy.
May ka mashma lan? tenena: hannoten et eruvo bevet shaar achsadra umirpeset — eno eruv. eruv hu dela have, ha shittuf have?

Bet shaar deyachid vaavir demavoy itztericha leh, dela tenan. tanya name hachi: hannoten et eruvo bevet shaar achsadra umirpeset uvechatzer uvemavoy — hare ze eruv. vehatnan: en ze eruv! ema: hare ze shittuf.
Shittuf bemavoy la minnetar? ema: bechatzer shebbemavoy.
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: bene chavura shehayu mesubbin vekiddesh alehen hayyom, pat sheal hashshulchan somchin alehen mishshum eruv. veamri la: mishshum shittuf.
Amar rabba, vela peligi: kan — bimsubbin babbayit, kan — bimsubbin bechatzer.

Amar leh abbaye lerabba: tanya dimsayyay lach: eruve chatzerot bechatzer, veshittufe mevoot bammavoy. vehavenan ba, eruve chatzerot bechatzer? vehatnan: hannoten et eruvo bevet shaar achsadra umirpeset eno eruv! ema: eruve chatzerot — babbayit shebbechatzer, shittufe mevoot — bechatzer shebbammavoy.
Rabbi yehuda omer: im yesh sham tefisat yad vechulei. hechi dame tefisat yad? kegon chatzero shel bonyays.
Ben bonyays ata lekammeh derabbi, amar lehu: pannu makom leven mea mane. ata inish acharina, amar lehu:

a: Pannu makom leven matayim mane. amar lefanav rabbi yishmael berabbi yose: rabbi, aviv shel ze yesh lo elef sefinot bayyam, uchenegdan elef ayayrot bayyabbasha. amar lo: lichshettaggia etzel aviv emor lo: al teshaggerehu bakkelim hallalu lefanay.

Rabbi mechabbed ashirim. rabbi akiva mechabbed ashirim. kiddaresh rava bar mari: "yeshev olam lifne elohim chesed veemet man yintzeruhu" — ematay yeshev olam lifne elohim? bizman shechesed veemet man yintzeruhu.
Rabba bar bar chana amar: kegon yated shel macharesha.
Amar rav nachman, tana deve shemuel: davar hannittal beshabbat — oser. davar sheeno nittal beshabbat — eno oser.
Tanya name hachi: yesh lo tevel, yesh lo ashashit, vechol davar sheeno nittal beshabbat — eno oser.
Mishna hammanniach beto vehalach lishbot beir acheret, echad nochri veechad yisrael — hare ze oser, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer: eno oser.
Rabbi yose omer: nochri — oser, yisrael — eno oser, sheen derech yisrael lavo bashshabbat.
Rabbi shimon omer: afillu hinniach beto vehalach lishbot etzel bitto beotah hair — eno oser, shekkevar hissia millibbo.
Gemara amar rav: halacha kerabbi shimon. vedavka bitto, aval beno — la. deamri inashe: nevach bach kalba — ul, nevach bach gurayyta — pok.
Mishna bor shebben shete chatzerot — en memallein mimmennu bashshabbat, ella im ken asu lo mechitza gevoha asara tefachim, ben millematta, ben mittoch ogno.
Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: bet shammay omrim millematta, uvet hillel omrim millemala. amar rabbi yehuda: lo tehe mechitza gedola min hakkotel shebbenehem.
Gemara amar rav huna: lematta — lematta mammash, lemala — lemala mammash, veze vaze bevor. verav yehuda amar: lematta — lematta min hammayim, lemala — lemala min hammayim.
Amar leh rabba bar rav chanan leabbaye: ha deamar rav yehuda "lematta — lematta min hammayim", may shena lematta mammash dela? daarivi mayya. lematta min hammayim name, ha arivi mayya?!
Amar leh: la shemia lach ha deamar rav yehuda amar rav, umatu bah mishshum rabbi chiyyay: tzarich sheyyerau roshan shel kanim lemala min hammayim tefach.

Vetu, ha deamar rav yehuda: "lemala — lemala min hammayim". may shena lemala mammash dela? daarivi mayya. lemala min hammayim name, ha arivi mayya?! amar leh: la shemia lach ha detane yaakov karchinaa: tzarich sheyyeshakka rashe kanim bammayim tefach.
Veella ha deamar rav yehuda: kora arba matteret bechureba, verav nachman amar rabba bar avu:
b: Kora arbaa matteret bemayim.
Ha ka azel deli leiddach gisa, umayyte? kim lehu lerabbanan deen deli mehallech yoter mearbaa tefachim.

Tachat kora miha ha arivi mayya! ella mishshum dekal hu shehekellu chachamim bemayim. kediva minneh rabbi tavla merav: mechitza teluya, mahu shettattir bechureba? amar leh: en mechitza teluya matteret ella bemayim, kal hu shehekellu chachamim bammayim.
Amar rabbi yehuda, lo tehe mechitza. amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: rabbi yehuda beshitat rabbi yose amarah, deamar: mechitza teluya matteret afillu bayyabbasha.
Ditnan: hameshalshel defanot millemala lematta, bizman sheggevohot min haaretz shelosha tefachim — pesula. mimmatta lemala, im gevohot asara tefachim — keshera.
Rabbi yose omer: keshem shemmillematta lemala asara, kach millemala lematta asara.
Vela hi, la rabbi yehuda savar la kerabbi yose vela rabbi yose savar la kerabbi yehuda.
Rabbi yehuda la savar la kerabbi yose: ad kan la kaamar rabbi yehuda ella beeruve chatzerot derabbanan, aval sukka deorayyta — la.
Vela rabbi yose savar la kerabbi yehuda: ad kan la kaamar rabbi yose ella besukka deissur ase hu, aval shabbat deissur sekila hu — lo amar.
Veim tomar: oto maase shennaasa betzippori, al pi mi naasa? lo al pi rabbi yose, ella al pi rabbi yishmael berabbi yose naasa.
Dechi ata rav dimi, amar: paam achat shachchu velo heviu sefer tora mibbeod yom. lemachar parsu sadin al haammudim, veheviu sefer tora vekaru bo.
Parsu?! lechattechilla mi shere? veha hakkol modim sheen osin ohel aray beshabbat.
Ella: matzu sedinin perusin al haammudim, veheviu sefer tora vekaru bo.

Amar rabba: rabbi yehuda verabbi chananya ben akavya amru davar echad. rabbi yehuda, ha daamaran. rabbi chananya ben akavya, (ditnan) rabbi chananya ben akavya omer: gezuzetra sheyyesh bah arba ammot al arba ammot

a: Chokek bah arba al arba umemalle.
Amar leh abbaye: vedilma la hi, ad kan la kaamar rabbi yehuda hatam, ella deamar: "gud achet mechitzta", aval "kof vegud" — la.
Vead kan la kaamar rabbi chananya ben akavya hatam, ella beyammah shel teverya, hoil veyesh lah oganim, vaayayrot vekarpefot makkifot otah, aval bishar memot — lo.
Amar abbaye: uledivre rabbi chananya ben akavya, hayta semucha lakkotel befachot mishshelosha tefachim — tzarich sheyyehe orkah arba ammot, verochbah achad asar umashshehu.
Hayta zekufa — tzarich sheyyehe govhah asara tefachim, verochbah shishsha tefachim ushene mashshehuyin.
Amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua: hayta omedet bekeren zavit — tzarich sheyyehe govhah asara tefachim, verochbah shene tefachim ushene mashshehuyin.
Veella ha detanya, rabbi chananya ben akavya omer: gezuzetra sheyyesh bah arba ammot al arba ammot — chokek bah arbaa al arbaa umemalle, hechi mashkachat la?
Daavida ki asita.

Mishna ammat hammayim shehi overet bechatzer — en memallein hemenna beshabbat, ella im ken asu lah mechitza gevoha asara tefachim bichnisa uvitzia. rabbi yehuda omer: kotel sheal gabbah tiddon mishshum mechitza.
Amar rabbi yehuda: maase beamma shel avel, shehayu memallein mimmenna al pi zekenim beshabbat! amru lo: mippene shello haya bah kashshiur.

Gemara tanu rabbanan: asu lah bichnisa velo asu lah bitzia, asu lah bitzia velo asu lah bichnisa — en memallein hemenna beshabbat, ella im ken asu lah mechitza asara tefachim bitzia uvichnisa. rabbi yehuda omer: kotel sheal gabbah tiddon mishshum mechitza.
Amar rabbi yehuda: maase beammat hammayim shehayta baa meavel letzippori, vehayu memallein hemenna beshabbat al pi hazzekenim.
Amru lo: mishsham reayay?! mippene shello hayta amukka asara tefachim verochbah arbaa.

Tanya iddach: ammat hammayim haoveret ben hachallonot, pachot mishshelosha — meshalshel deli umemalle. shelosha — en meshalshel deli umemalle. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: pachot mearbaa — meshalshel deli umemalle, arbaa — en meshalshel deli umemalle.
Bemay askinan? ilema: beammat hammayim gufa, veella ha dechi ata rav dimi amar rabbi yochanan: en karmelit pechuta mearbaa —
Lema ketannae amra lishmateh?
Ella baagappeha, ulehachlif.
Veha ki ata rav dimi amar rabbi yochanan: makom sheen bo arbaa al arbaa — muttar livne reshut hayyachid velivne reshut harabbim lechattef alav, uvilvad shello yachlifu.
Hatam reshuyot deorayyta,
b: Hacha reshuyot derabbanan.
Veha rabbi yochanan barshuyot derabbanan name amar, (detanya): kotel shebben shete chatzerot, gavoah asara tefachim verochav arbaa — mearvin shenayim, veen mearvin echad.
Hayu berosho perot — ellu olin mikkan veochlin, veellu olin mikkan veochlin.
Nifratz hakkotel, ad eser ammot — mearvin shenayim, veim ratzu mearvin echad, mippene shehu kefetach. yoter mikkan — mearvin echad veen mearvin shenayim.
Vehavenan ba: en bo arbaa may? amar rav: avir shete reshuyot sholetet bo, velo yaziz bo melo nima.
Verabbi yochanan amar: ellu maalin mikkan veochlin, veellu maalin mikkan veochlin.
Veazda rabbi yochanan letameh, dechi ata rav dimi amar rabbi yochanan: makom sheen bo arbaa al arbaa — muttar livne reshut harabbim velivne reshut hayyachid lechattef alav, uvilvad shello yachalifu!
Hahi zeeri amra. velizeri kashya ha!
Zeeri mokem la beammat hammayim gufa. verav dimi tannae hi.
Vetihve ki chore karmelit!
Abbaye bar avin verav chanina bar avin deamri tarvayyhu: en chorin lecharmelit.
Rav ashe amar: afillu tema yesh chorin lecharmelit — hane mille bismucha. hacha, bemufeleget.
Ravina amar: kegon daavad la nifke appumma.
Veazdu rabbanan letamayyhu, verabbi shimon ben gamliel letameh.
Mishna gezuzetra shehi lemala min hammayim en memallein hemenna beshabbat ella im ken asu lah mechitza gevoha asara tefachim, ben millemala, ben millematta.
Vechen shete gezuzetraot zo lemala mizzo, asu leelyona velo asu letachtona — shetehen asurot ad sheyyearvu.
Gemara matnitin dela kachananya ben akavya. detanya, chananya ben akavya omer: gezuzetra sheyyesh bah arba al arba ammot chokek bah arbaa al arbaa, umemalle.
Amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi yose ben zimra: lo hittir rabbi chananya ben akavya ella beyammah shel teverya, hoil veyesh lah oganim, vaayayrot vekarpefot makkifot otah, aval bishar memot — lo.
Tanu rabbanan: shelosha devarim hittir rabbi chananya ben akavya leanshe teverya: memallein mayim miggezuzetra bashshabbat, vetomnin beetza, umistappegin baalunetit.
Memallein mayim miggezuzetra bashshabbat: ha daamaran. vetomnin beetza may hi, detanya: hishkim lehavi pesolet, im bishvil sheyyesh alav tal — hare hu bechi yuttan",
Veim bishvil shello yibbatel mimmelachto — eno bechi yuttan". usetam

a: Anshe teverya kemi shello yivtal mimmelachto dame.

Umistappegin baalunetit may hi, detanya: mistappeg adam baalunetit, umannichah bachallon. velo yimserenna laolyayrin mippene shechashudin al oto davar. rabbi shimon omer: af meviah beyado letoch beto.
Amar rabba bar rav huna: lo shanu ella lemalloot, aval lishpoch — asur.
Matkef la rav shezvi: vechi ma ben ze leuka?
Hane tayymi, vehane la tayymi.

Ikka deamri, amar rabba bar rav huna: la tema lemalloot hu dishre, lishpoch asur, ella lishpoch name shere. amar rav shezvi: peshita — hayeynu uka! mahu detema: hane tayymi vehane la tayymi, ka mashma lan.
Vechen shete gezuzetraot zo vechulei. amar rav huna amar rav: lo shanu ella bismucha, aval bemufeleget — elyona mutteret.
Verav letameh, daamar rav: en adam oser al chavero derech avir.
Amar rabba amar rabbi chiyyay, verav yosef amar rabbi oshaya: yesh gazel beshabbat. vechureba machazir labbealim.
Ha gufa kashya: amrat "yesh gazel beshabbat" — alma kanya, "vechureba machazir livalim" — alma la kanya!
Hachi kaamar: yesh din gazel beshabbat, ketzad — dechureba machazir labbealim.
Amar rabba, umotvinan ashshematin: vechen shete gezuzetraot zo lemala mizzo vechulei. vei amrat yesh din gazel beshabbat, ammay asurot?
Amar rav sheshet: hacha bemay askinan, kegon sheasu mechitza beshuttafut.
I hachi, ki asu lattachtona name!
Kevan deasu lattachtona — galloye galli data daana bahadach la nicha li.
Mishna chatzer shehi pechuta mearba ammot — en shofchin betochah mayim beshabbat, ella im ken asu lah uka machzeket satayim min hannekev ulematta.
Ben mibbachutz, ben mibbifnim. ella shemmibbachutz — tzarich likmor, mibbifnim — en tzarich likmor.

Rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer: biv shehu kamur arba ammot birshut harabbim — shofchim letocho mayim bashshabbat. vachachamim omrim: afillu gag o chatzer mea amma — lo yishpoch al pi habbiv, aval shofech hu laggag, vehammayim yordin labbiv.
Hechatzer vehaachsadra mitztarfin learba ammot. vechen shete deyotaot zo keneged zo, miktzatan asu uka umiktzatan lo asu uka, et sheasu uka — muttarin, et shello asu uka — asurin.
Gemara may tama? amar rabba: mippene sheadam asuy lehistappek satayim mayim bechol yom, bearba ammot — adam rotze lezallefan,
b: Pachot mearba — shofchan. i daavid uka — shere, i la — asur.
Rabbi zera amar: arba ammot — tayymi, pachot mearba ammot — la tayymi.
May benayyhu? amar abbaye: arich vekattin ikka benayyhu.
Tenan: chatzer veachsadra mitztarfin learba ammot. bishlama lerabbi zera nicha, ella lerabba kashya!
Targema rabbi zera allibba derabba beachsadra mehallechet al pene kol hechatzer kullah.
Ta shema: chatzer sheen bah arba ammot al arba ammot — en shofchin letochah mayim bashshabbat. bishlama lerabba nicha, ella lerabbi zera kashya!
Amar lach rabbi zera: ha manni rabbanan hi, umatnitin rabbi eliezer ben yaakov hi.
Umay duchekeh derabbi zera leokoma lematnitin kerabbi eliezer ben yaakov? amar rava: matnitin keshiteh, may irya detane "chatzer shehi pechuta", litne: "chatzer sheen bah arba ammot al arba ammot"!
Ella lav shema minna, derabbi eliezer ben yaakov hi. shema minna.
Veha middesefa rabbi eliezer ben yaakov, resha lav rabbi eliezer ben yaakov!

Kulla rabbi eliezer ben yaakov hi, vechassore michassera, vehachi katane: chatzer shehi pechuta mearba ammot — en shofchin letochah mayim beshabbat, ha arba ammot — shofchin, sherabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer: biv hakkamur arba ammot birshut harabbim — shofchin letocho mayim bashshabbat.
Rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer: biv hakkamur.
Matnitin dela kachananya. detanya, chananya omer: afillu gag mea amma — lo yishpoch, lefi sheen haggag asuy livloa, ella lekalleach.
Tana: bamme devarim amurim — bimot hachamma, aval bimot haggeshamim — shofech veshone veeno nimna. may tama? amar rava: adam rotze sheyyibbalu mayim bimkoman.
Amar leh abbaye: vahare shofchin, deadam rotze sheyyibbalu, vekatane "lo yishpoch"!
Amar leh: hatam lemay nechush la, i mishshum kilkul chatzero — ha mikkalkela vekayyma. vei mishshum gezera shemma yomru "tzinnoro shel peloni mekalleach mayim" — setam tzinnorot mekallechim hem.
Amar rav nachman: bimot haggeshamim, uka machazik satayim — notnin lo satayim, machazik sea — notnin lo sea. bimot hachamma, machazik satayim — notnin lo satayim, sea — en notnin lo kol ikkar.
Bimot hachamma name, machazik sea nittev leh sea! gezera dilma ate litten leh satayim. i hachi bimot haggeshamim name ligzor!
Hatam may nechush la? i mishshum kilkul — ha mikkalkela vekayyma. i mishshum gezera "shemma yomru tzinnoro shel peloni mekalleach mayim" — setam tzinnorot mekallechin hen.
Amar abbaye: hilkach, afillu kor vaafillu korayim.
Vechen shete deyotaot zo keneged zo. amar rava: afillu ervu.

Amar (leh) abbaye: may tama? illema mishshum nefisha demayya, vehatanya: achat li uka, veachat li gistera berecha vaareva, af al pi shennitmalleu mayim meerev shabbat — shofchin letochan mayim bashshabbat!
Ella, i ittemar, hachi ittemar: amar rava

a: Lo shanu ella shello ervu, aval ervu — muttarin.
Vechi lo ervu, may tama la? amar rav ashe: gezera dilma ate leappoke mimmane devattim lehatam.
Haderan alach ketzad mishtattefin
Mishna kol gaggot hair reshut achat, uvilvad shello yehe gag gavoah asara o namuch asara, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim: kol echad veechad reshut bifne atzmo.
Rabbi shimon omer: echad gaggot veechad chatzerot veechad karpefot — reshut achat hen lechelim sheshshavtu letochan, velo lechelim sheshshavtu betoch habbayit.
Gemara yatev abbaye bar avin verabbi chanina bar avin, veyatev abbaye gabbayyhu, veyatvi vekaamri: bishlama rabbanan savri keshem sheddiyyurin chalukin lematta, kach diyyurin chalukin lemala.

Ella rabbi meir may kasavar? i kasavar: keshem sheddiyyurin chalukin lematta, kach diyyurin chalukin lemala, ammay reshut achat hen? vei kasavar en chalukin, dechol lemala measara reshut achat hi — afillu gag gavoah asara venamuch asara, name!

Amar lehu abbaye: la shemia lechu ha deamar rav yitzchak bar avdimi, omer haya rabbi meir: kol makom sheatta motze shete reshuyot vehen reshut achat, kegon ammud birshut hayyachid gavoah asara verachav arbaa — asur lechattef alav, gezera mishshum tel birshut harabbim. hachi name, gezera mishshum tel birshut harabbim.
Sevur minna afillu machteshet vaafillu gigit.
Amar lehu abbaye, hachi amar mar: lo amar rabbi meir ella ammud veammat harechayim, hoil veadam kovea lahen makom.
Vahare kotel shebben shete chatzerot, dekavua, veamar rav yehuda: keshettimtze lomar, ledivre rabbi meir: gaggin reshut leatzman, chatzerot reshut leatzman, karpefot reshut leatzman.
May lav, dishre letaltole derech kotel!
Amar rav huna bar yehuda amar rav sheshet: la, lehachenis ulehotzi derech petachim.
Vachachamim omrim kol echad veechad reshut bifne atzmo. ittemar, rav amar: en metaltelin bo ella bearba ammot, ushemuel amar: muttar letaltel bechullo.
Bimchitzot hannikkarot — dechulle alma la peligi. ki peligi — bimchitzot sheenan nikkarot.
Rav amar: en metaltelin bo ella bearba ammot — la amar: "gud assek mechitzta". ushemuel amar: muttar letaltel bechullo — deamar: "gud assek mechitzta".
Tenan, vachachamim omrim: kol echad veechad
b: Reshut leatzmo. bishlama lishmuel nicha, ella lerav kashya.
Amri be rav mishshemeh derav: shello yetaltel shete ammot begag ze, ushete ammot begag ze.
Veha amar rabbi elazar: ki havenan bevavel hava amrinan: be rav mishshemeh derav amru: en metaltelin bo ella bearba ammot, vehane deve shemuel tanu: en lahen ella gaggan.

May "en lahen ella gaggan", lav dishru letaltole bechulleh? umi allima mimmatnitin, deokemna shello yetaltel shete ammot begag ze ushete ammot begag ze?! hachi name, shete ammot begag ze ushete ammot begag ze.
Amar rav yosef: la shemia li ha shemata. amar leh abbaye: at amart nihalan, veaha amart nihalan: gag gadol hassamuch lekatan — haggadol muttar, vehakkatan asur.
Vaamart lan ala: amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: lo shanu ella sheyyesh diyyurin al ze vediyyurin al ze, dehavya la ha dekatan mechitza nidreset.
Aval en diyyurin al ze veal ze — shenehen muttarin.
Amar leh: ana hachi amari lechu: lo shanu ella sheyyesh mechitza al ze umechitza al ze, degadol mishtere begippufe, vekatan nifratz bimloo. aval en mechitza lo al ze velo al ze — shenehen asurin.
Veha diyyurin amart lan! i amari lechu diyyurin, hachi amari lechu: lo shanu ella sheyyesh mechitza reuya ledira al ze umechitza reuya ledira al ze, degadol mishtere begippufe vekatan nifratz bimloo.
Aval yesh mechitza reuya ledira al haggadol, veen reuya ledira al hakkatan — afillu katan shere livne gadol. may tama? kevan dela avud mechitza, salloke salliku nafshayyhu mehacha.
Keha deamar rav nachman: asa sullam kavua legaggo — huttar bechol haggaggin kullan.
Amar abbaye: bana aliyyay al gabbe beto veasa lefaneha dakka arba — huttar bechol haggaggin kullan.
Amar rava: peamim shehaddakka leissur, hechi dame — daavida lahade tarbitza deveteh, deamar

a: Lenattore tarbitza hu daavida.
Beay rame bar chama: shete ammot begag ushete ammot beammud mahu? amar rabba: may ka mibbaya leh, karmelit ureshut hayyachid ka mibbaya leh?
Verame bar chama aggav churepeh la ayyen ba, ella hachi kamibbaya leh: shete ammot begag ushete ammot beachsadra, mahu?
Mi amrinan: kevan dela hay chaze ledira vela hay chaze ledira — chada reshuta hi. o dilma: kevan demiggag legag asir, miggag leachsadra name asir.
Bae rav bivi bar abbaye: shete ammot begag ushete ammot bechureba, mahu?
Amar rav kahana: lav hayeynu derame bar chama?! amar rav bivi bar abbaye: vechi meacher atay unetzay? achsadra la chazya ledira, vechureba chazya ledira.
Vechi meachar dechazya ledira may kamibbaya leh! "im timtze lomar" kaamar: im timtze lomar achsadra la chazya ledira — chureba chazya ledira? o dilma: hasheta miha let ba dayorin. teku.
Gaggin hashshavin lerabbi meir, vegag yechidi lerabbanan, rav amar: muttar letaltel bechullo, ushemuel amar: en metaltelin bo ella bearba.
Rav amar: muttar letaltel bechullo, kashya derav adderav! hatam la minnachra mechitzta. hacha minnachra mechitzta.

Ushemuel amar: en metaltelin bo ella bearba ammot, kashya dishmuel addishmuel! hatam, la have yoter mibbet satayim. hacha, have yoter mibbet satayim, vehane mechitzot lematta avidan, lemala la avidan, vehave kekarpef yater mibbet satayim shello hukkaf ledira, vechol karpef yoter mibbet satayim shello hukkaf ledira — en metaltelin bo ella bearba.
Ittemar, sefina. rav amar: muttar letaltel bechullah, ushemuel amar: en metaltelin bah ella bearba. rav amar: muttar letaltel bechullah —
b: Deha ikka mechitzata. ushemuel amar: en metaltelin bah ella bearba ammot — mechitzot lehaveriach mayim asuyot.
Amar leh rav chiyyay bar yosef lishmuel: hilcheta kevotach o hilcheta kerav? amar leh: hilcheta kerav.
Amar rav giddel amar rav chiyyay bar yosef: umode rav sheim kefaah al piha, sheen metaltelin bah ella bearba ammot. kefaah, lemay? ilema ladur tachteha, may shena miggag yechidi?
Ella shekkefaah lezoftah.
Rav ashe matne la assefina, verav acha bereh derava matne la aachsadra. deittemar, achsadra bevika. rav amar: muttar letaltel bechullah, ushemuel amar: en metaltelin bah ella bearba.
Rav amar: muttar letaltel bechullah — amrinan pi tikra yored vesotem. ushemuel amar: en metaltelin bah ella bearba — la amrinan pi tikra yored vesotem.
Verav allibba derabbi meir, littaltele miggag lechatzer?! gezera mishshum derav yitzchak bar avdimi.
Ushemuel allibba derabbanan, nittaltel miggag lekarpef. amar rava bar ulla: gezera shemma yippachet haggag.
I hachi, mikkarpef lekarpef name la yetaltel, dilma mippechit veate letaltole? hatam, i mippechit minnachra leh milleta. hacha, i mippechit la minnachra milleta.
Amar rav yehuda: keshettimtza lomar, ledivre rabbi meir gaggin reshut leatzman, chatzerot reshut leatzman,

a: Karpefot reshut leatzman. ledivre chachamim: gaggin vachatzerot reshut achat, karpefot reshut achat hen. ledivre rabbi shimon: kullan reshut achat hen.

Tanya kevoteh derav, tanya kevoteh derav yehuda. tanya kevoteh derav: kol gaggot hair reshut achat hen, veasur lehaalot ulehorid min haggaggin lechatzer umin hechatzer legaggin. vechelim sheshshavtu bechatzer — muttar letaltelan bechatzer, baggaggin — muttar letaltelan baggaggin, uvilvad shello yehe gag gavoah asara o namuch asara, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim: kol echad veechad reshut leatzmo, veen metaltelin bo ella bearba.

Tanya kevoteh derav yehuda: amar rabbi, keshehayinu lomdim tora etzel rabbi shimon bitkoa, hayinu maalin shemen vaalunetit miggag legag, umiggag lechatzer, umechatzer lechatzer, umechatzer lekarpef, umikkarpef lekarpef acher, ad shehayinu maggiin etzel hammayayn shehayinu rochatzin bo.
Amar rabbi yehuda: maase bishat hassakkana vehayinu maalin tora mechatzer legag, umiggag lechatzer, umechatzer lekarpef likrot bo.
Amru lo: en sheat hassakkana reaya.
Rabbi shimon omer: echad gaggin vechulei.
Amar rav: halacha kerabbi shimon, vehu shello ervu. aval ervu — la, degazrinan dilma ate leappoke mane devattim lechatzer.
Ushemuel amar: ben ervu ben shello ervu. vechen amar rabbi yochanan: mi lechashcha, ben ervu uven shello ervu?
Matkef la rav chisda: lishmuel ulerabbi yochanan, yomru: shene chelim bechatzer achat, ze muttar veze asur!

Rabbi shimon letameh, dela gazar. ditnan, amar rabbi shimon: lema haddavar dome, leshalosh chatzerot happetuchot zo lazo ufetuchot lirshut harabbim, veervu shete hachitzonot im haemtzait — hi mutteret immahen, vehen muttarot immah, ushete hachitzonot asurin zo im zo.
Vela gazar dilma ate leappoke mane deha chatzer leha chatzer, hachi name la gazrinan dilma ate leappoke mane devattim lechatzer.

Metiv rav sheshet: rabbi shimon omer, echad gaggot echad chatzerot veechad karpefot reshut achat hen lechelim sheshshavtu betochan, velo lechelim sheshshavtu betoch habbayit. i amrat bishlama deervu — hayeynu demashkachat la mane devattim bechatzer.
Ella i amrat beshello ervu — hechi mashkachat la mane devattim bechatzer? hu motev la vehu mefarek la: bechumeta vesudara.
b: Ta shema: anshe chatzer veanshe mirpeset sheshshachchu velo ervu, kol sheggavoah asara tefachim — lammirpeset. pachot mikkan — lechatzer. bamme devarim amurim — shehayu ellu shel rabbim veellu shel rabbim, veervu ellu leatzman veellu leatzman. o shel yechidim sheen tzerichin learev.
Aval hayu shel rabbim, veshachchu velo ervu — gag vechatzer veachsadra umirpeset kullan reshut achat hen.
Tama delo ervu, ha ervu la! ha manni — rabbanan hi.
Dayka name, dela katane karpef umavoy. shema minna.

Ta shema: chamesh chatzerot happetuchot zo lazo ufetuchot lemavoy, veshachchu kullam velo ervu — asur lehachenis ulehotzi mechatzer lammavoy umin hammavoy lechatzer. vechelim sheshshavtu bechatzer — muttar letaltelan bechatzer, uvammavoy asur.
Verabbi shimon mattir. shehaya rabbi shimon omer: kol zeman shehen shel rabbim, veshachchu velo ervu, gag vechatzer veachsadra umirpeset vekarpef umavoy — kullan reshut achat hen.
Tama delo ervu, ha ervu — la. may "lo ervu": lo ervu chatzerot bahade hadade, ha chatzer uvattim — ervu.
Veha "lo ervu" katane! may "lo ervu": lo nishtattefu.
Veibbaet ema, rabbi shimon ledivrehem derabbanan kaamar lehu: ledidi la shena ervu, vela shena la ervu. ella ledidchu, odo li mihat dehecha delo ervu reshut achat hi.
Vaamaru leh rabbanan: la — shete reshuyot hen.
Amar mar: uvammavoy asur. lema mesayyay leh lerabbi zera amar rav, deamar rabbi zera amar rav: mavoy shello nishtattefu bo — en metaltelin ella bearba ammot. ema: ulemavoy — asur.
Hayeynu resha! mishna yattira itztericha leh, mahu detema: ki peligi rabbanan aleh derabbi shimon hane mille hecha deervu, aval hecha dela ervu — modu leh, ka mashma lan.
Amar leh ravina lerav ashe:

a: Mi amar rabbi yochanan hachi? veha amar rabbi yochanan: halacha kistam mishna. utenan: kotel shebben shete chatzerot, gavoah asara verochav arbaa — mearvin shenayim, veen mearvin echad. hayu berosho perot — ellu olin mikkan veochlim, veellu olin mikkan veochlim, uvilvad shello yoridu lematta?
May "lematta" — lematta labbattim. veha tane rabbi chiyyay: uvilvad shello yehe ze omed bimkomo veochel, veze omed bimkomo veochel!
Amar leh: vechi rabbi lo shenaah, rabbi chiyyay minnayin lo?
Ittemar: shete chatzerot vechureba achat benehem, achat erva veachat lo erva, amar rav huna: notnin otah lazo shello erva, aval lesheerva — la. dilma ate leappoke mane devattim lechureba.
Vechiyyay bar rav amar: af lesheerva, ushetehen asurot. veim tomar shetehen muttarot, mippene ma en notnin chatzer shello erva lechatzer sheerva?
Hatam, kevan deminnatri mane devattim bechatzer, ate leappoke. hacha bechureba, kevan dela minnatri mane dechatzer bechureba, la ate leappoke.

Ikka deamri, chiyyay bar rav amar: af lesheerva, ushetehen muttarot. veim tomar: shetehen asurot — lefi sheen notnim chatzer shello erva lechatzer sheerva. hatam, kevan deminnatri mane devattim bechatzer — la sharu behu rabbanan, deate leappoke. aval bechureba la minnatri.
Mishna gag gadol samuch lekatan — haggadol muttar, vehakkatan asur. chatzer gedola shennifretza liktanna — gedola mutteret uketanna asura, mippene shehi kefitchah shel gedola.
Gemara lema leh lemitne tarte?
Lerav, katane gag dumeya dechatzer: ma chatzer minnachra mechitzta, af gag name minnachra mechitzta.
Velishmuel, gag dumeya dechatzer: ma chatzer deka darsi la rabbim, af gag name deka darsi leh rabbim.
Yatev rabba verabbi zera verabba bar rav chanan, veyatev abbaye gabbayyhu, veyatvi vekaamri: shema minna mimmatnitin dayore gedola bakketanna, veen dayore ketanna baggedola.
Ketzad? gefanim baggedola — asur lizroa et hakketanna. veim zara — zerain asurin,
b: Gefanim muttarin. gefanim bakketanna — muttar lizroa et haggedola.
Ishsha baggedola vaget bakketanna — mitgareshet. ishsha bakketanna veget baggedola — enah mitgareshet.
Tzibbur baggedola usheliach tzibbur bakketanna — yotzin yede chovatan. tzibbur bakketanna usheliach tzibbur baggedola — en yotzin yede chovatan.
Tisha baggedola veyachid bakketanna — mitztarfin. tisha bakketanna veechad baggedola — en mitztarfin.
Tzoa baggedola — asur likrot keriat shema bakketanna. tzoa bakketanna — muttar likrot keriat shema baggedola.
Amar lehu abbaye: im ken, matzinu mechitza leissur. sheilmale en mechitza, marchik arba ammot vezorea, veillu hasheta asura!
Amar leh rabbi zera leabbaye: velo matzinu mechitza leissur?! veha tenan: chatzer gedola shennifretza liktanna — gedola mutteret uketanna asura, mippene shehi kefitchah shel gedola.
Veillu hishva et gippufeha gedola name asura!
Amar leh, hatam silluk mechitztzot hu.
Amar leh rava leabbaye: velo matzinu mechitza leissur? veha ittemar:

a: Sikkech al gabbe achsadra sheyyesh lah patztzimin — keshera. veillu hishva patztzimeha — pesula.
Amar leh abbaye: ledidi keshera, ledidach silluk mechitztzot hi.
Amar leh rabba bar rav chanan leabbaye: velo matzinu mechitza leissur? vehatanya: bayit shechetzyo mekore vechetzyo eno mekore, gefanim kan — muttar lizroa kan.
Veillu hishva et keruyo — asur. amar leh: hatam silluk mechitztzot hu.

Shelach leh rava leabbaye beyad rav shemaya bar zeera: velo matzinu mechitza leissur? vehatanya: yesh bimchitzot hakkerem lehakel ulehachamir, ketzad? kerem hannatua ad ikkar mechitza — zorea meikkar mechitza veelach. sheillu en sham mechitza marchik arba ammot vezorea, veze hu mechitztzot hakkerem lehakel.
Ulehachamir ketzad? haya mashuch min hakkotel achat esre amma — lo yavi zera lesham, sheilmale en mechitza marchik arba ammot vezorea, vezohi mechitzot hakkerem lehachemir.

Amar leh: velitamaych, otvan mimmatnitin, ditnan: karachat hakkerem, bet shammay omrim: esrim vearba ammot, uvet hillel omrim: shesh esre amma. mechol hakkerem, bet shammay omrim: shesh esre amma, uvet hillel omrim: shetem esre amma.
Veezo hi karachat hakkerem? kerem shecharav emtzaito. im en sham shesh esre amma — lo yavi zera lesham, hayu sham shesh esre amma — noten lo kede avodato, vezorea et hammotar.
E zo hi mechol hakkerem? ben hakkerem laggader. sheim en sham shetem esre amma — lo yavi zera lesham, hayu sham shetem esre amma — noten lo kede avodato, vezorea et hammotar.
Ella — hatam lav hayeynu tama, dechol arba ammot legabbe cherem avodat hakkerem. legabbe gader, kevan dela mizdaran — afkore mafkar lehu. devene bene, i ikka arba — chashivan, vei la — la chashivan.
Amar rav yehuda: shelosha karpefot ze betzad ze, ushenayim hachitzonim meguppafim, vehaemtzai eno meguppaf, veyachid baze veyachid baze — naase kishyayra, venotnin lahen kol tzorkan vadday.
Emtzai meguppaf ushenayim hachitzonim enan meguppafin, veyachid baze veyachid ze [veyachid baze] — en notnin lahem ella bet shesh.
Ibbaya lehu: echad baze veechad baze ushenayim baemtzai, mahu? i lehacha nafki — telata havu, vei lehacha nafki — telata havu.
O dilma: chad lehacha nafek, vechad lehacha nafek.

Veim timtze lomar chad lehacha nafek vechad lehacha nafek, shenayim baze ushenayim baze veechad beemtzai mahu? hacha vadday, i lehacha nafek — telata havu, vei lehacha nafek — telata havu, o dilma: emar lehacha nafek, veemar lehacha nafek.
Vehilcheta bayayn lekulla.
Amar rav chisda:
b: Giddud chamishsha umechitza chamishsha — en mitztarfin ad sheyyehe o kullo begiddud o kullo bimchitza.

Metivi: shete chatzerot zo lemala mizzo veelyona gevoha min hattachtona asara tefachim, o sheyyesh bah giddud chamishsha umechitza chamishsha — mearvin shenayim, veen mearvin echad. pachot mikkan mearvin echad, veen mearvin shenayim!
Amar (rav): mode rav chisda battachtona, hoil veroe pene asara. i hachi: tachtona — tearev shenayim velo tearev echad, elyona — lo tearev lo echad velo shenayim.
Amar rabba bar ulla: kegon shehayta elyona meguppefet ad eser ammot.
I hachi, ema sefa: pachot mikkan — mearvin echad veen mearvin shenayim, i baaya — chad tearev, i baaya — tere tearev!
Amar rabba bereh derava: kegon shennifretza hattachtona bimloah laelyona.
I hachi, tachtona chad tearev, tere la tearev. elyona, i baaya — tere tearev, i baaya — chad tearev.
In hachi name. vechi katane "pachot mikkan mearvin echad veen mearvin shenayim", attachtona.

Derash marimar: giddud chamishsha umechitza chamishsha — mitztarfin. ashkecheh ravina lerav acha bereh derava, amar leh: tane mar midde bimchitza? amar leh: la. vehilcheta: giddud chamishsha umechitza chamishsha mitztarfin.
Bae rav hoshaya: dayorin habbain beshabbat, mahu sheyyeasru?
Amar rav chisda, ta shema: chatzer gedola shennifretza liktanna — haggedola mutteret vehakketanna asura, mippene shehi kefitchah shel gedola. amar rabba: emar mibbeod yom nifretza.

Amar leh abbaye: la tema mar "emar", ella vadday mibbeod yom nifretza. deha mar hu deamar, beay minneh merav huna uveay minneh merav yehuda: erav derech happetach venistam happetach, erav derech challon venistam hachallon, mahu? veamar li: shabbat, kevan shehuttera huttera.
Ittemar, kotel shebben shete chatzerot shennafal, rav amar: en metaltelin bo ella bearba ammot.
Ushemuel amar:

a: Ze metaltel ad ikkar mechitza, veze metaltel ad ikkar mechitza.
Veha derav lav beferush ittemar, ella mikkelala ittemar. derav ushemuel havo yatvi behahu chatzer, nefal gudda devene bene, amar lehu shemuel: shekulu gelima, negidu ba.
Ahderinhu rav leappeh. amar lehu shemuel: i kafed abba, shekulu hemyayneh uketaru bah.
Velishmuel lema li ha? ha amar: ze metaltel ad ikkar mechitza veze metaltel ad ikkar mechitza!
Shemuel aved litzniuta bealma.
Verav, i sevira leh daasir — lema leh! atreh dishmuel hava.
I hachi, may tama ahderinhu leappeh? dela nemru kishmuel sevira leh (vahadar beh mishshemateh).
Mishna chatzer shennifretza lirshut harabbim — hammachnis mittochah lirshut hayyachid, o mershut hayyachid letochah — chayyayv, divre rabbi eliezer.
Vachachamim omrim: mittochah lirshut harabbim o mershut harabbim letochah — patur, mippene shehi kecharmelit.
Gemara verabbi eliezer, mishshum denifretza lirshut harabbim havya la reshut harabbim?! in, rabbi eliezer letameh,
Detanya, rabbi yehuda omer mishshum rabbi eliezer: rabbim shebberru derech leatzman, ma shebberru berru.
Ini?! vehaamar rav giddel amar rav: vehu sheavda lahen derech beoto sade.
Vechi tema: hacha name kegon sheavda lahen derech beotah chatzer, vehaamar rabbi chanina: ad mekom mechitza machaloket.
Ema: al mekom mechitza machaloket.
Veibbaet ema, betzidde reshut harabbim kamippalgi, derabbi eliezer savar: tzidde reshut harabbim — kirshut harabbim damu, verabbanan savri tzidde reshut harabbim — lav kirshut harabbim damu.

Veliflog betzidde reshut harabbim bealma? i ippeligu betzidde reshut harabbim bealma, hava amrinan: ki peligi rabbanan aleh derabbi eliezer — hane mille hecha deikka chippufe, aval hecha delekka chippufe — ema modu leh, ka mashma lan.
Veha "mittochah" kaamar!
Ayyeyde daamur rabbanan "mittochah", amar ihu name "mittochah".
Verabbanan, amar rabbi eliezer tzidde reshut harabbim, umahderu leh inhu "mittochah"!
Hachi kaamri leh rabbanan lerabbi eliezer: mi la ka modet lan hecha detiltel mittochah lirshut harabbim, umershut harabbim letochah — defatur, mippene shehi karmelit? tzidde name la shena.
Verabbi eliezer, hatam la ka darsi la rabbim, hacha ka darsi la rabbim.

Mishna chatzer shennifretza lirshut harabbim mishte ruchoteha, vechen bayit shennifratz mishte ruchotav, vechen mavoy shennittelu korotav o lechayav — muttarim beoto shabbat, vaasurim leatid lavo, divre rabbi yehuda.
Rabbi yose omer: im muttarin leoto shabbat — muttarin leatid lavo, veim asurin leatid lavo — asurin leoto shabbat.
Gemara bemay askinan? ilema beeser, may shena meruach achat deamar pitcha hu, mishte ruchot name pitcha hu! ella beyater meeser, i hachi — afillu meruach achat name!
Amar rav: leolam beeser,
b: Uchegon shennifretza bekeren zavit. defitcha bekeren zavit la avdi inashe.
Vechen bayit shennifratz mishte ruchotav. may shena meruach achat, deamrinan: pi tikra yored vesotem. mishte ruchot name lema: pi tikra yored vesotem!
Amri deve rav mishshemeh derav: kegon shennifratz bekeren zavit vekeruyo baalachson, delekka lememar pi tikra yored vesotem.
Ushemuel amar: afillu beyater meeser. i hachi, meruach achat name!
Mishshum bayit.
Uvayit gufeh tikshe: may shena meruach achat, deamrinan pi tikra yored vesotem, mishshete ruchot name nema: pi tikra yored vesotem!
Vetu: mi it leh lishmuel pi tikra yored vesotem? veha ittemar: achsadra bevika, rav amar: muttar letaltel bechullah, ushemuel amar: en metaltelin bah ella bearba ammot!
Ha la kashya: ki let leh — bearba, aval beshalosh — it leh.
Mikkol makom kashya!
Kidamri be rav mishshemeh derav: kegon shennifratz bekeren zavit vekeruyo baalachson, hacha name, kegon shennifratz bekeren zavit vekeruyo bearba.
Shemuel lo amar kerav, alachson la katane. verav la amar kishmuel, im ken havya leh achsadra, verav letameh deamar: achsadra muttar letaltel bechullah.
Deittemar, achsadra bevika. rav amar: muttar letaltel bechullah. ushemuel amar: en metaltelin bah ella bearba ammot.
Rav amar: muttar letaltel bechullah, amrinan pi tikra yored vesotem. ushemuel amar: en metaltelin bah ella bearba ammot, la amrinan pi tikra yored vesotem.
Beeser — kulle alma la peligi. ki peligi — beyater meeser.
Veikka deamri, beyater — kulle alma la peligi. ki peligi — beeser.
Veha deamar rav yehuda:

a: Kora arbaa mattir bechureba, verav nachman amar rabba bar avu: kora arbaa mattir bemayim, manni?
Lehach lishshana deamrat beeser la peligi: beeser, vedivre hakkol. lehach lishshana deamrat beeser peligi: kerav.
Lema abbaye verava biflugeta derav ushemuel kamippalgi, deittemar: sikkech al gabbe achsadra sheyyesh lah patztzimin — keshera, en lah patztzimin, abbaye amar: keshera, verava amar: pesula.
Abbaye amar keshera, amar pi tikra yored vesotem. verava amar pesula, la amar pi tikra yored vesotem. lema abbaye kerav, verava kishmuel?

Allibba dishmuel kulle alma la feligi. ki peligi allibba derav: abbaye kerav. verava — ad kan la kaamar rav hatam, ella dehane mechitzot leachsadra avidi. aval hacha, dehane mechitzot lav lesukka avidi — la.
Rabbi yose omer: im muttarin. ibbaya lehu rabbi yose leesor, o lehattir?
Amar rav sheshet: leesor. vechen amar rabbi yochanan: leesor. tanya name hachi, amar rabbi yose: keshem sheasurin leatid lavo, kach asurin leoto shabbat.
Ittemar, rav chiyyay bar yosef amar: halacha kerabbi yose, ushemuel amar: halacha kerabbi yehuda.

Umi amar shemuel hachi?! vehatnan, amar rabbi yehuda: bamme devarim amurim, beeruve techumin. aval beeruve chatzerot — mearvin ben ledaat ben shello ledaat, lefi shezzachin leadam shello befanav, veen chavin shello befanav.
Veamar rav yehuda amar shemuel: halacha kerabbi yehuda. velo od, ella kol makom sheshshana rabbi yehuda beeruvin — halacha kemoto.
Vaamar leh rav chana bagdataa lerav yehuda: amar shemuel afillu bemavoy shennittal korato o lechayav? vaamar leh: beeruvin amarti lecha, velo bimchitzot.
Amar rav anan: ledidi mipparsha li minneh dishmuel: kan shennifretza lecharmelit, kan shennifretza lirshut harabbim.
Mishna habbone aliyyay al gabbe shene vattim, vechen gesharim hamefullashim — metaltelin tachtehen bashshabbat, divre rabbi yehuda. vachachamim osrin.
Veod amar rabbi yehuda: mearvin lemavoy hamefullash. vachachamim osrin.
Gemara amar rabba: la tema hayeynu tama derabbi yehuda mishshum deka savar shete mechitzot deorayyta. ella mishshum dekasavar: pi tikra yored vesotem.

Etiveh abbaye: yater al ken amar rabbi yehuda: mi sheyyesh lo shene vattim mishshene tzidde reshut harabbim, ose lechi mikkan velechi mikkan, o kora mikkan vekora mikkan, venose venoten baemtza. amru lo: en mearvin reshut harabbim bechach!
Amar leh: mehahi — in, meha — lekka lemishma minna.
Amar rav ashe: matnitin name dayka, middekatane: veod amar rabbi yehuda: mearvin bemavoy hamefullash, vachachamim osrin.
I amrat bishlama mishshum deka savar pi tikra yored vesotem — hayeynu dekatane "veod".
Ella i amrat mishshum deka savar shete mechitzot deorayyta — may "veod"?! shema minna.
Haderan alach kol gaggot
Mishna hammotze tefillin — machnisan zug zug. rabban gamliel omer: shenayim shenayim. bamme devarim amurim — bishanot, aval bachadashot — patur.
Metzaan tzevatim o cherichot — machshich alehen umevian.
b: Uvassakkana — mechassan veholech lo.
Rabbi shimon omer: notnan lachavero, vachavero lachavero, ad shemmaggia lechatzer hachitzona.

Vechen beno — notno lachavero, vachavero lachavero, afillu mea. rabbi yehuda omer: noten adam chavit lachavero, vachavero lachavero, afillu chutz lattechum. amru lo: lo tehallech zo yoter meragle vealeha.
Gemara zug echad in, tefe — la. lema tenan setama dela kerabbi meir?

Dei kerabbi meir, haamar: lovesh kol ma sheyyachol lilbosh, veotef kol ma sheyyachol laatof. ditnan: ulesham motzi kol kele tashmisho, velovesh kol ma sheyyachol lilbosh, veotef kol ma sheyyachol laatof.
Vehahi setama, mimmay derabbi meir hi? dekatane ala: lovesh umotzi ufoshet, velovesh umotzi ufoshet, afillu kol hayyom kullo, divre rabbi meir.
Amar rava: afillu tema rabbi meir, hatam derech malbusho — kechol shavvyu rabbanan, vehacha derech malbusho — kechol shavvyu rabbanan.
Hatam divchol kamma devae lavesh, leinyan hatztzala name sharu le rabbanan. hacha divchol name zug echad — in, tefe — la, leinyan hatztzala name zug echad — in, tefe — la.
Rabban gamliel omer: shenayim shenayim. may kasavar? i kasavar shabbat zeman tefillin hu, zug echad — in, tefe — la.
Vei kasavar shabbat lav zeman tefillin hu, umishshum hatztzala derech malbush sharu leh rabbanan, afillu tefe name!
Leolam kasavar shabbat lav zeman tefillin hu, vechi shero rabbanan leinyan hatztzala — derech malbush bimkom tefillin.
I hachi zug echad name — en, tefe — la! amar rav shemuel bar rav yitzchak: makom yesh barosh lehanniach bo shete tefillin.
Hanicha derosh, deyad may ikka lememar?
Kidrav huna, deamar rav huna: peamim sheadam ba min hassade vachavilato al rosho, umesallekan merosho vekoshran bizroo.
Emar deamar rav huna, shello yinhag bahen derech bizzayon. rauy mi amar?
Ella kidamar rav shemuel bar rav yitzchak: makom yesh barosh sherauy lehanniach bo shete tefillin. hacha name, makom yesh bayyad sherauy lehanniach bo shete tefillin.
Tanna deve menashshe: "al yadcha" — zo kibboret, "ben enecha" — zo kodkod. hecha? amri deve rabbi yannay: mekom shemmocho shel tinok rofes.
Lema bidrav shemuel bar rav yitzchak kamippalgi, detanna kamma let leh derav shemuel bar rav yitzchak, verabban gamliel it leh derav shemuel bar rav yitzchak?
La, dechulle alma it lehu derav shemuel bar rav yitzchak, vehacha beshabbat zeman tefillin kamippalgi. detanna kamma savar: shabbat zeman tefillin hu.
Verabban gamliel savar: shabbat lav zeman tefillin hu.
Veibbaet ema: dechulle alma shabbat zeman tefillin hu, vehacha bemitzvot tzerichot kauona kamippalgi. tanna kamma savar: latzet bae kauona.
Verabban gamliel savar: la bae kauona.

a: Veibbaet ema: dechulle alma latzet la bae kauona, vehacha laavor mishshum "bal tosif" kamippalgi, detanna kamma savar: laavor mishshum "bal tosif" la bae kauona. verabban gamliel savar: laavor mishshum "bal tosif" bae kauona.
Veibbaet ema: i disvira lan deshabbat zeman tefillin — dechulle alma la laavor bae kauona vela latzet bae kauona.
Vehacha belaavor shello bizmanno" kamippalgi. tanna kamma savar: la bae kauona. verabban gamliel savar: laavor shello bizmanno bae kauona.
I hachi, lerabbi meir zug echad name la.
Veod: hayyashen bashshemini besukka yilke! ella mechavvavrta chidshanninan meikkara.

Uman shamat leh shabbat zeman tefillin? rabbi akiva. detanya: "veshamarta et hachukka hazzot lemoadah miyyamim yamima". "yamim" — velo lelot. "miyyamim" — velo kol yamim, perat leshabbatot veyamim tovim, divre rabbi yose haggelili.
Rabbi akiva omer: lo neemar chukka zo ella leinyan pesach bilvad.

Veella ha ditnan: happesach vehammila mitzvat ase — lema dela kerabbi akiva, dei rabbi akiva — kevan demoke lah befesach, lav name ikka, kidrabbi avin amar rabbi ilay. deamar rabbi avin amar rabbi ilay: kol makom shenneemar "hishshamer" "pen" veal" — eno ella belo taase!
Afillu tema rabbi akiva, "hishshamer" delav — lav, "hishshamer" daase — ase.

Vesavar rabbi akiva shabbat zeman tefillin hu?! vehatanya, rabbi akiva omer: yachol yanniach adam tefillin beshabbatot veyamim tovim, talmud lomar: "vehaya lecha leot al yadcha", mi shetztzerichin ot, yatzu ellu — shehen gufan ot.

Ella hay tanna hu detanya: hanneor ballayla, ratza — choletz, ratza — manniach, divre rabbi natan. yonatan hakkitoni omer: en mannichin tefillin ballayla. middelayla letanna kamma zeman tefillin — shabbat name zeman tefillin.
Dilma sevira leh layla zeman tefillin hu, shabbat lav zeman tefillin hu. deha shaminan leh lerabbi akiva deamar: layla zeman tefillin hu, shabbat lav zeman tefillin hu!

Ella hay tanna hu detanya: michal bat kushi hayta mannachat tefillin velo michu bah chachamim, veishto shel yona hayta ola laregel velo michu bah chachamim. middelo michu bah chachamim — alma kasavri mitzvat ase shello hazzeman gerama hi.
Vedilma savar la
b: Kerabbi yose, deamar: nashim somchot reshut.
Dei la tema hachi, ishto shel yona hayta ola laregel velo michu bah, mi ikka leman deamar regel lav mitzvat ase shehazzeman gerama hu? ella kasavar reshut, hacha name reshut.
Ella hay tanna hi detanya: hammotze tefillin, machnisan zug zug. echad haish veechad haishsha, echad chadashot veechad yeshanot, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda oser bachadashot, umattir bishanot.
Ad kan la peligi ella bachadashot vishanot, aval beishsha la peligi. shema minna mitzvat ase shello hazzeman gerama hu, vechol mitzvat ase sheen hazzeman gerama nashim chayyayvot.
Vedilma savar la kerabbi yose, deamar: nashim somchot reshut? la salka datach dela rabbi meir savar la kerabbi yose, vela rabbi yehuda savar la kerabbi yose
La rabbi meir savar la kerabbi yose, ditnan: en meakkevin et hattinokot millitkoa. ha nashim meakkevin — usetam matnitin rabbi meir.
Vela rabbi yehuda savar la kerabbi yose, detanya: "dabber el bene yisrael ... vesamach", bene yisrael somchin veen benot yisrael somchot. rabbi yose verabbi shimon omrim: nashim somchot reshut.
Usetam sifra manni — rabbi yehuda.
Amar rabbi elazar: hammotze techelet bashshuk, leshonot — pesulot, chutin — kesherin.
May shena leshonot, deamar: addata diglima tzavinhu? chutin name, nema: addata diglima tevinhu! bishzurim.
Shezurim name, nema: addata desifta diglima ayyfinhu! bemufesakin, dechulle hay vadday la tarchi inashe.
Amar rava: vechi adam toreach laasot kamea kemin tefillin? ditnan: bamme devarim amurim, bishanot. aval bachadashot — patur.
Amar rabbi zera leahava bereh: pok teni lehu: hammotze techelet bashshuk, leshonot — pesulin, chutin mufesakin — kesherin, lefi sheen adam toreach.
Amar rava: umishshum detane la ahava bereh derabbi zera kefe tela la?! vehatnan: bamme devarim amurim — bishanot, aval bachadashot — patur!
Ella amar rava: tarach vela tarach — tannae hi.
Detanya: hammotze tefillin — machnisan zug zug, echad haish veechad haishsha,

a: Echad chadashot veechad yeshanot, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda oser bachadashot umattir bishanot. alma mar savar tarach inish, umar savar la tarach inish.

(410 172 Siman.) vehasheta detane avu dishmuel bar rav yitzchak: ellu hen yeshanot — kol sheyyesh bahen retzuot umekushsharot, chadashot — yesh bahen retzuot velo mekushsharot. dechulle alma la tarach inish.
Velinevinhu minav! amar rav chisda: zot omeret, aniva pesula bitfillin.
Abbaye amar: rabbi yehuda letameh, deamar: aniva keshira meallayyta hi.

Tama daaniva keshira meallayyta hi, ha lav hachi — anev lehu, vehaamar rav yehuda bereh derav shemuel bar shilat mishshemeh derav: kesher shel tefillin halacha lemoshe missinay hu, veamar rav nachman: venoyehen levar!
Deanev lehu keen keshira didhu.
Amar rav chisda amar rav: hallokeach tefillin mimmi sheeno mumeche — bodek shetayim shel yad veachat shel rosh, o shetayim shel rosh veachat shel yad.
Ma nafshach: i mechad gavra ka zaven, livdok o shalosh shel yad o shalosh shel rosh.
I mittere telata gavre zaven, kol chad vechad live bedika. leolam mechad gavra zaven, uvaenan demitmache beshel yad uveshel rosh.
Ini?! veha tane rabba bar shemuel: bitfillin bodek shalosh shel yad veshel rosh, may lav o shalosh shel yad o shalosh shel rosh! la: shalosh, mehen shel yad mehen shel rosh.
Vehatane rav kahana: bitfillin bodek shetayim shel yad veshel rosh! ha manni rabbi hi, deamar: bitre zimne have chazaka.
I rabbi, ema sefa: vechen batztzevet hashsheni, vechen batztzevet hashshelishi. vei rabbi — shelishi mi it leh?
Mode rabbi bitzvatim, demittere telata gavre zaven. i hachi afillu revii name, vaafillu chamishi name!
In hachi name. vehay dekatane shelishi leappoke mechezkeh, uleolam afillu revii vachamishi name.
Metzaan tzevatim o cherichot vechulei. may tzevatim umay kerichot? amar rav yehuda amar rav: hen hen tzevatim, hen hen kerichot. tzevatim — zavevy zavevy, kerichot — dichrichan tuva.

Machshich alehen umevian. veammay? leayyeylinhu zug zug! amar rav yitzchak bereh derav yehuda: ledidi mipparsha leh minneh deabba, kol sheillu machnisan zug zug vechalot kodem shekiat hachamma, machnisan zug zug. vei la, machshich alehen umevian.
Uvassakkana mechassan veholech. vehatanya: uvassakkana molichan pachot pachot mearba ammot! amar rav: la kashya: ha — besakkanat goyim, ha — besakkanat listim.
b: Amar leh abbaye: bemay okemta lematnitin, besakkanat goyim? ema sefa, rabbi shimon omer: notnan lachavero, vachavero lachavero. kol shekken deavvsha milleta!
Chassore michassera, vehachi katane: bamme devarim amurim — besakkanat goyim, aval besakkanat listim — molichan pachot pachot mearba ammot.
Rabbi shimon omer: notnan lachavero vechulei. bemay kamippalgi? mar savar: pachot mearba ammot adif, dei amrat notnan lachavero vachavero lachavero — avvsha milleta deshabbat.
Umar savar: notnan lachavero adif, dei amrat molichan pachot mearba ammot — zimnin delav addateh, veate leetoyinhu arba ammot birshut harabbim.
Vechen beno. beno may bae hatam? deve menashshe tana: besheyyeladattu immo bassade.
Umay afillu hen mea? deaf al gav dekashya leh yeda, afillu hachi, ha adifa.
Rabbi yehuda omer: noten adam chavit. velet leh lerabbi yehuda ha ditnan habbehema vehakkelim keragle habbealim!
Amar resh lakish mishshum levi sava: hacha bemay askinan bimaran mechavit lechavit. verabbi yehuda letameh, deamar: mayim en bahem mammash.
Ditnan: rabbi yehuda poter bemayim mippene sheen bahen mammash.
Umay lo tehallech zo — lo yehallech ma shebbezo yoter meragle habbealim.

Emar deshamat leh lerabbi yehuda hecha divlian beissa, hecha deitanhu beenayyhu mi shamat leh? hasheta bikdera amar rabbi yehuda la batli, beenayyhu batli?! detanya, rabbi yehuda omer: mayim umelach betelin baissa. veen betelin bakkedera, mippene rotbah.
Ella amar rava, hacha bechavit shekkanta shevita, umayim shello kanu shevita askinan. devatla chavit legabbe mayim.
Keditnan: hammotzi hachay bemitta — patur af al hammitta, mippene shehammitta tefela lo.
Hammotzi ochalin pachot mikkashshiur — bichli patur af al hakkeli, mippene shehakkeli tafel lo.
Metiv rav yosef, rabbi yehuda omer: bishyayra, noten adam chavit lachavero vachavero lachavero. bishyayra in, shello bishyayra la? ella amar rav yosef: ki tenan name bematnitin — bishyayra tenan.
Abbaye amar: bishyayra — afillu chavit shekkanta shevita umayim shekkanu shevita. shello bishyayra — chavit shekkanta shevita umayim shello kanu shevita.

Rav ashe amar: hacha bechavit dehefker askinan umayim dehefker askinan. uman amru lo — rabbi yochanan ben nuri hi, deamar: cheftze hefker konin shevita. umay "lo tehallech zo yoter meragle habbealim"? lo yehallechu ellu yoter mikkelim sheyyesh lahem bealim.
Mishna haya kore besefer al haiskuppa venitgalgel hassefer miyyado — gollo etzlo.
Haya kore berosh haggag venitgalgel hassefer miyyado, ad shello higgia laasara tefachim — gollo etzlo. mishshehiggia laasara tefachim — hofcho al hakketav.
Rabbi yehuda omer: afillu en mesullak min haaretz ella kimlo machat — gollo etzlo. rabbi shimon omer: afillu baaretz atzmo — gollo etzlo, sheen lecha davar mishshum shevut omed bifne kitve hakkodesh.
Gemara hay iskuppa hechi dame? illema iskuppa reshut hayyachid vekama reshut harabbim, vela gazrinan dilma nafel veate leetoye.

a: Manni? rabbi shimon hi, deamar: kol davar shehu mishshum shevut eno omed bifne kitve hakkodesh. ema sefa rabbi yehuda omer: afillu en mesullak min haaretz ella melo hachut gollo etzlo. rabbi shimon omer: afillu baaretz atzmah gollo etzlo —
Resha vesefa rabbi shimon, metziata rabbi yehuda! amar rav yehuda: in, resha vesefa rabbi shimon, metziata rabbi yehuda.
Rabba amar: hacha beiskuppa hannidreset askinan, umishshum bizyon kitve hakkodesh shero rabbanan.
Etiveh abbaye: toch arba ammot — gollo etzlo, chutz learba — hofcho al hakketav. vei amrat beiskuppa nidreset askinan, ma li toch arba ammot ma li chutz learba ammot?
Ella amar abbaye: hacha beiskuppa karmelit askinan, ureshut harabbim overet lefaneha.
Toch arba ammot, dei nafel umayyti leh la ate lide chiyyuv chattat — sharu leh rabbanan.
Chutz learba ammot, dei mayyte leh ate lide chiyyuv chattat — la sharu leh rabbanan.

I hachi, toch arba ammot name nigzar dilma meayyel mershut harabbim lirshut hayyachid. vechi tema kevan demafseket karmelit let lan ba, vehaamar rava: hammaavir chefetz mittechillat arba lesof arba, veheeviro derech alav — chayyayv.
Hacha bemay askinan, beiskuppa arukka, addehachi vehachi middechar.
Veibbaet ema: leolam beiskuppa sheenah arukka, usetam kitve hakkodesh ayyone meayyen behu umannach lehu. velechush dilma meayyen behu birshut harabbim veayel lehu behedya lirshut hayyachid.
Ha manni ben azzay hi, deamar: mehallech keomed dame. vedilma zarek lehu mizrak, deamar rabbi yochanan: mode ben azzay bezorek.
Amar rav acha bar ahava: zot omeret en mezarkin kitve hakkodesh.
Haya kore berosh haggag vechulei. umi shere? vehatanya: kotve sefarim tefillin umezuzot lo hittiru lahen lehappech yeria al paneha, ella pores aleha et habbeged!
Hatam efshar, hacha la efshar, vei la afech ikka bizyon kitve hakkodesh tefe.
Hofcho al hakketav? veha la nach! [amar rava:] bechotel meshuppa.
[Amar leh abbaye:] bemay okemta lematnitin? bechotel meshuppa, ema sefa, rabbi yehuda omer: afillu eno mesullak min haaretz ella melo hachut — gollo etzlo, veha nach leh!
Chassore michassera, vehachi katane: bamme devarim amurim — bechotel meshuppa, aval
b: Bechotel sheeno meshuppa, lemala mishshelosha — gollo etzlo, lematta mishshelosha — hofcho al hakketav.
Rabbi yehuda omer afillu eno mesullak min haaretz vechulei. devaenan hannacha al gabbe mashshehu.
Veella ha deamar rava: toch shelosha lerabbanan tzarich hannacha, lema ketannae amra lishmateh?!

Ella: kulla rabbi yehuda hi, vechassore michassera, vehachi katane: bamme devarim amurim — bechotel meshuppa, aval bechotel sheeno meshuppa — afillu pachot mishshelosha tefachim gollo etzlo. sherabbi yehuda omer: afillu eno mesullak min haaretz ella melo hachut — gollo etzlo.
May tama? devaenan hannacha al gabbe mashshehu.
Mishna ziz shellifne challon — notnin alav venotlin mimmennu beshabbat.
Gemara hay ziz demappek lehecha? illema demappek lirshut harabbim — lechush dilma nafel, veate leetoye. ella demappek lirshut hayyachid, peshita!
Amar abbaye: leolam demappek lirshut harabbim, umay "notnin alav" dekatane, kelim hannishbarim.
Tanya name hachi: ziz shellifne hachallon hayyotze lirshut harabbim — notnin alav kearot vechosot, kitoniyyot utzelochiyyot.
Umishtammesh bechol hakkotel ad asara hattachtonim. veim yesh ziz echad lematta mimmennu — mishtammesh bo, uvaelyon en mishtammesh bo ella keneged challono.
Hay ziz hechi dame? i delet beh arbaa — mekom petur hu, vaafillu keneged challono name la yishtammesh. vei it beh arbaa — bechulle hakkotel lishtammesh.
Amar abbaye: tachton deit beh arbaa, veelyon let beh arbaa vechallon mashlimato learbaa. keneged challon — mishtammesh, dechore challon hu. dehay gisa udehay gisa — asur.
Mishna omed adam birshut hayyachid umetaltel birshut harabbim. birshut harabbim umetaltel birshut hayyachid, uvilvad shello yotzi chutz mearba ammot.
Lo yaamod adam birshut hayyachid veyashtin birshut harabbim, birshut harabbim veyashtin birshut hayyachid, vechen lo yarok.
Rabbi yehuda omer: af mishshennitlash rukko befiv, lo yehallech arba ammot ad sheyyarok.
Gemara matne leh rav chinnana bar shelemya lechiyyay bar rav kammeh derav: lo yaamod adam birshut hayyachid umetaltel birshut harabbim. amar leh: shavkat rabbanan veavdat kerabbi meir?!

a: Hu savar: middesefa rabbi meir, resha name rabbi meir. vela hi: sefa rabbi meir, veresha rabbanan.
Uvilvad shello yotzi chutz. ha hotzi chayyayv chattat. lema mesayyay leh lerava, deamar rava: hammaavir chefetz mittechillat arba lesof arba, veheeviro derech alav — chayyayv.
Mi katane: im hotzi chayyayv chattat? dilma im hotzi — patur aval asur.

Ikka deamri: ha hotzi patur aval asur, lema tehve teyuveteh derava, deamar rava: hammaavir mittechillat arba lesof arba veheeviro derech alav chayyayv! mi katane "hotzi patur aval asur"? dilma: im hotzi — chayyayv chattat.
Lo yaamod adam birshut hayyachid vechulei. amar rav yosef: hishtin verak — chayyayv chattat.
Veha bainan akira vehannacha meal gabbe mekom arbaa, velekka!
Machshavto meshavveya leh makom. dei la tema hachi, ha deamar rava: zarak venach befi hakkelev o befi hakkivshan chayyayv chattat, veha bainan hannacha al gabbe mekom arbaa, velekka!
Ella: machshavto meshavveya leh makom, hachi name machshava meshavveya lah makom.
Bae rava: hu birshut hayyachid ufi amma birshut harabbim, mahu? batar akira azlinan, o batar yetzia azlinan? teku.
Vechen lo yarok. rabbi yehuda omer vechulei. af al gav dela happech bah?
Vehatnan: haya ochel devela beyadayim mesoavot, vehichnis yado letoch piv littol tzeror — rabbi meir metamme, verabbi yose metaher.
Rabbi yehuda omer: hippech bah — tame. lo hippech bah — tahor!
Amar rabbi yochanan: muchelefet hashshita.
Resh lakish amar: leolam la tachlef, vehacha bemay askinan? bechicho.

Vehattanya, rabbi yehuda omer: kicho venitlash, may lav — rok venitlash! la, kicho venitlash. veha tanya, rabbi yehuda omer: kicho shennitlash, vechen rukko shennitlash, lo yehallech arba ammot ad sheyyarok! ella mechavvavrta chidshanninan meikkara.
Amar resh lakish: kiyyach bifne rabbo chayyayv mita, shenneemar "kol mesanay ahavu mavet" — al tikre "limsanay", ella "lemasniay".
Veha menas anis? kiyyach verak kaamrinan.
Mishna lo yaamod adam birshut hayyachid veyishte birshut harabbim, birshut harabbim veyishte birshut hayyachid, ella im ken hichnis rosho verubbo limkom shehu shote. vechen baggat.
Gemara resha rabbanan, vesefa rabbi meir!
Amar rav yosef: bachafetzin shetztzerichin lo, vedivre hakkol.
Ibbaya lehu: karmelit, may? amar abbaye: hi hi. amar rava: hi gufa gezera, vaanan nekum venigzor gezera ligzera?!
Amar abbaye: mena amena la, middekatane
b: Vechen baggat.
Verava amar: leinyan maaser. vechen amar rav sheshet: "vechen baggat" — leinyan maaser.
Ditnan: shotin al haggat, ben bechammin uven betzonen, ufatur — divre rabbi meir. rabbi eliezer bar tzadok mechayyev.
Vachachamim omrim: al hachammin chayyayv, veal hatztzonen patur. mippene shemmachazir et hammotar.
Mishna kolet adam min hammazchela lematta measara tefachim, umin hatztzinnor mikkol makom shote.
Gemara kolet — in, aval metzaref — la. may tama? amar rav nachman: hacha bemazchela pachot mishshelosha samuch laggag askinan, dechol pachot mishshelosha samuch laggag, kegag dame.
Tanya name hachi: omed adam birshut hayyachid umagbiah yado lemala measara tefachim lefachot mishshelosha samuch laggag, vekolet, uvilvad shello yetzaref.
Tanya iddach: lo yaamod adam birshut hayyachid veyagbiah yado lemala measara tefachim lefachot mishshelosha samuch laggag vitzaref, aval kolet hu veshote.
Min hatztzinnor mikkol makom shote. tana: im yesh betzinnor arbaa al arbaa — asur, mippene shehu kemotzi mershut lirshut.
Mishna bor birshut harabbim vechuleyayto gavoah asara tefachim, challon sheal gabbav memallein hemennu beshabbat.
Ashpa birshut harabbim gevoha asara tefachim, challon sheal gabbav shofchin letochah mayim beshabbat.
Gemara bemay askinan? ilema bismucha, lema li chuleya asara?
Amar rav huna: hacha bemay askinan? bemufeleget min hakkotel arbaa.
Vetama deikka chuleya asara, ha lekka chuleya asara — ka metaltel mershut hayyachid lirshut hayyachid derech reshut harabbim.
Verabbi yochanan amar: afillu tema bismucha — ha ka mashma lan devor vechuleyayto mitztarfin laasara.
Ashpa birshut harabbim vechulei. vela chayyshinan shemma tinnatel ashpa?
Veha ravin bar rav adda amar rabbi yitzchak: maase bemavoy echad shetztziddo echad kale layyam vetziddo echad kale leashpa, uva maase lifne rabbi, velo amar bo lo issur velo hetter.
Hetter lo amar bo — dechayyshinan shemma tinnatel ashpa, veyaale hayyam sirton.
Issur lo amar bo — deha kayymin mechitzot.
La kashya: ha — deyachid, ha — derabbim.
Mishna ilan shehaya mesech al haaretz, im en gufo gavoah min haaretz shelosha tefachim — metaltelim tachtav.
Shorashav gevohim min haaretz shelosha tefachim — lo yeshev alehen.
Gemara amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua: en metaltelin bo yater mibbet satayim, may tama?

a: Mishshum dehave dira shettashmishah laavir, vechol dira shettashmishah laavir — en metaltelin bah yater mibbet satayim.
Shorashav gevohin min haaretz vechulei. ittemar: shorshe ilan habbain millemala mishshelosha letoch shelosha, rabba amar: muttar lehishtammesh bahen, rav sheshet amar: asur lehishtammesh bahen.
Rabba amar: muttar lehishtammesh bahen, dechol pachot mishshelosha deara — ara hi. rav sheshet amar: asur lehishtammesh bahen, dechevan demikkoach issur kaate — asurin.
Dedamu kimshunnita, desalkin leella — asurin. denachatin letattay — sheru. litzdadin — pelugeta derabba verav sheshet.
Vechen annigra, vechen bekeren zavit.
Hahu dikla dahava leabbaye, vahava salek beippuma. ata lekammeh derav yosef ushera leh.
Amar rav acha bar tachlifa: dishra lach, kerabba shera lach.
Peshita? mahu detema afillu lerav sheshet beta keman dimle dame, velishtammesh befachot mishshelosha samuch laggag, ka mashma lan.
Tenan: shorashav gevohin min haaretz shelosha tefachim — lo yeshev alehem. hechi dame? i dela hadri kayfi — peshita. ella lav, af al gav dehadri kayfi!
La, leolam dela hadari kayfi, veha ka mashma lan af al gav detziddo echad shave laaretz.

Tanu rabbanan shorshe ilan sheggevohin min haaretz shelosha tefachim o sheyyesh chalal tachtehen shelosha tefachim, af al pi shetztziddo echad shave laaretz — hare ze lo yeshev alehen, lefi sheen olin beilan, veen nitlin beilan, veen nishanin beilan.
Velo yaale beilan mibbeod yom veyeshev sham kol hayyom kullo. echad ilan veechad kol habbehema, aval bor shiach umeara vegader — metappes veole metappes veyored, vaafillu hen mea amma.
Tane chada: im ala — muttar lered, vetane chada — asur lered. la kashya: kan — mibbeod yom, kan — mishshechashecha.
Veibbaet ema, ha veha mishshechashecha, vela kashya: kan — beshogeg, kan — bemezid.
Veibbaet ema, ha veha beshogeg, vehacha bekansu shogeg attu mezid kamippalgi. mar savar: kansinan. umar savar: la kansinan.
Amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua: ketannae. hannittanin bemattana achat shennitarvu benittanin mattana achat — yinnatnu bemattana achat, mattan arba bemattan arba — yinnatnu bemattan arba.
Mattan arba bemattan achat, rabbi eliezer omer: yinnatnu bemattan arba. verabbi yehoshua omer: yinnatnu bemattana achat.
Amar lo rabbi eliezer: hare hu over al "bal tigra"! amar lo rabbi yehoshua: hare hu over beval tosif".
Amar rabbi eliezer: lo amru ella keshehu beatzmo. amar lo rabbi yehoshua: lo neemar "bal tigra" ella keshehu beatzmo.
Veod amar rabbi yehoshua: keshennatatta — avarta al "bal tosif" veasita maase beyadecha. keshello natatta — avarta al "bal tigra" velo asita maase beyadecha.
Lerabbi eliezer deamar hatam "kum ase" adif, hachi name yered. lerabbi yehoshua deamar hatam "shev veal taase" adif, hachi name lo yered.
Dilma la hi, ad kan la kaamar rabbi eliezer hatam "kum ase" adif — ella deka aved mitzva. aval hacha dela aved mitzva, hachi name lo yered.
Vei name, ad kan la kaamar rabbi yehoshua hatam "shev veal taase" adif — ella
b: Dela ka aved issura, aval hacha deka aved issura, hachi name deyered.
Tane chada: echad ilan lach veechad ilan yavesh, vetanya iddach: bamme devarim amurim — belach, aval beyavesh — muttar.
Amar rav yehuda, la kashya: kan — besheggizo machlif, kan — besheen gizo machlif.
Gizo machlif yavesh karet leh! ella la kashya: kan — bimot hachamma, kan — bimot haggeshamim.
Bimot hachamma, ha natri pere! bidlikka pere. veha ka natri kinse! begidduda.
Ini?! veha rav ikkela leafsatya, vaasar begidduda! rav bika matza, vegadar bah gader.
Amar rame bar abba amar rav assi: asur leadam sheyyehallech al gabbe asavim beshabbat, mishshum shenneemar: "veatz beraglayim chote".
Tane chada: muttar lelech al gabbe asavim beshabbat, vetanya iddach: asur. la kashya: ha — belachim, ha — biveshim.
Vei baet ema, ha veha belachim, vela kashya: kan — bimot hachamma, kan — bimot haggeshamim.
Veibbaet ema, ha veha bimot hachamma, vela kashya: ha — desayem mesaneh, ha — dela sayem mesaneh.
Veibbaet ema: ha veha desayem mesaneh, vela kashya: ha — deit leh uketze, ha — delet leh uketze.
Veibbaet ema, ha veha deit leh uketze: ha — deit leh sheracha, ha — delet leh sheracha.
Vehaiddana dekayyma lan kerabbi shimon, kullehu shere.
Veamar rame bar chama amar rav assi: asur leadam sheyyachof ishto lidvar mitzva, shenneemar: "veatz beraglayim chote".
Veamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: kol hakkofe ishto lidvar mitzva havyayn lo banim sheenan mehugganin. amar rav ika bar chinnana, may keraa: "gam belo daat nefesh lo tov".
Tanya name hachi: "gam belo daat nefesh lo tov" — ze hakkofe ishto lidvar mitzva. "veatz beraglayim chote" — ze habboel veshone.
Ini?! vehaamar rava: harotze laasot kol banav zecharim yivol veyishne! la kashya: kan — ledaat, kan — shello ledaat.

Amar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yochanan: kol ishsha shettovaat balah lidvar mitzva hovin lah banim sheafillu bedoro shel moshe lo hayu kemotan. deillu bedoro shel moshe ketiv: "havu lachem anashim chachamim unevonim viduim leshivtechem", uchetiv: "vaekkach et rashe shivtechem anashim chachamim viduim", veillu nevonim la ashkach.

Veillu gabbe lea ketiv: "vattetze lea likrato vattomer elay tavo ki sachor secharticha", uchetiv: "umibbene yissashchar yode vina laittim ladaat ma yaase yisrael rashehem matayim vechol achehem al pihem".
Ini?! vehaamar rav yitzchak bar avdimi: eser kelalot nitkallela chavva, dichtiv:
"El haishsha amar hareba arbe", ellu shene tippe damim — achat dam nidda, veachat dam betulim. "itztzevonech", ze tzaar giddul banim. "veheronech", ze tzaar haibbur. "beetzev teldi banim", kemashmao.

"Veel ishech teshukatech", melammed shehaishsha mishtokeket al balah beshaa sheyyotze ladderech. "vehu yimshol bach", melammed shehaishsha tovaat ballev vehaish tovea bappe. zo hi midda tova bannashim.
Ki kaamrinan, demartzeya artzoye kammeh.
Hane sheva havvyan! ki ata rav dimi amar: atufa keavel, umenudda mikkol adam, vachavusha bevet haasurin.
May menudda mikkol adam? illema mishshum daasir la yichud, ihu name asir leh yichud. ella daasira leve tere.
Bematnita tana: megaddelet sear kelilit, veyoshevet umashtenet mayim kivhema, venaaset kar levalah.
Veiddach? hane shevach hu lah.

Deamar rabbi chiyyay, may dichtiv: "mallefenu mibbahamot aretz umeof hashshamayim yechakkemenu". "mallefenu mibbahamot" — zo pereda, shekkoraat umashtenet mayim. "umeof hashshamayim yechakkemenu" — ze tarnegol, shemmefayyes veachar kach boel.
Amar rabbi yochanan: ilmale lo nittena tora, hayinu lemedin tzeniut mechatul, vegazel minnemala, vaarayot miyyona. derech eretz mittarnegol — shemmefayyes veachar kach boel.
Umay mefayyes la? amar rav yehuda amar rav, hachi kaamar la: zavenna lich ziga dematu lich ad karaych, levatar hachi amar la: lishmatteh lecharbalteh dehahu tarnegola i it leh vela zavenna lich.

a: Mishna haddelet shebbammuketze, vachadakim shebbappirtza, umachtzalot — en noalin bahen ella im ken gevohim min haaretz.
Gemara ureminhu: delet hannigreret umachtzelet hannigreret, vekankan hannigrar, bizman shekkeshurin uteluyin — noalin bahen beshabbat, veen tzarich lomar beyom tov!
Amar abbaye: besheyyesh lahem tzir, rava amar: beshehaya lahen tzir.
Metivi: delet hannigreret, umachtzelet hannigreret, vekankan hannigrar, bizman shekkeshurin uteluyin ugevohim min haaretz afillu melo nima — noalin bahen, veim lav — en noalin bahen!
Abbaye metaretz letameh, verava metaretz letameh. abbaye metaretz letameh: o sheyyesh lahen tzir, o sheggevohin min haaretz. rava metaretz letameh: keshehaya lahen tzir, o sheggevohin min haaretz.
Tanu rabbanan: soche kotzim vachavilin shehitkinan lefirtza shebbechatzer, bizman shekkeshurin uteluyin — noalin bahen beshabbat, veen tzarich lomar beyom tov.
Tane rabbi chiyyay: delet almana hannigreret — en noalin bah. hechi dame delet almana? ikka deamri dechad shifa, veikka deamri delet leh gashma.
Amar rav yehuda: hay medureta, mimmala lematta — shere, mimmatta lemala — asir.
Vechen beata, vechen kidra, vechen pureya, vechen chavita.

Amar leh hahu mina lerabbi yehoshua ben chananya: chidkaa! dichtiv bechu "tovam kechedek". amar leh: shatya, shefel lesefeh dikra, dichtiv: "yashar mimmesucha". veella may "tovam kechedek"? keshem shechadakim hallalu meginnin al happirtza, kach tovim shebbanu meginnim alenu. davar acher: "tovam kechedek", shemmehaddekin et ummot haolam legehinnam, shenneemar: "kumi vadoshi vat tziyyon ki karnech asim barzel ufarsotayich asim nechusha vahadikkot ammim rabbim vegomer".
Mishna lo yaamod adam birshut hayyachid veyiftach birshut harabbim, birshut harabbim veyiftach birshut hayyachid, ella im ken asa mechitza gevoha asara tefachim, divre rabbi meir.
Amru lo: maase beshuk shel pattamim shehaya birushalayim, veshehayu noalin umannichin et hammafteach bachallon sheal gabbe happetach. rabbi yose omer: shuk shel tzammarim hava.

Gemara verabbanan, amar rabbi meir reshut harabbim — umahderu inhu karmelit! deamar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: yerushalayim ilmale daltoteha ninalot ballayla — chayyayvin aleha mishshum reshut harabbim.
Amar rav pappa: kan — kodem shennifretzu bah peratzot, kan — leachar shennifretzu bah peratzot.
Rava amar: sefa atan leshaare ginna, vehachi kaamar: vechen lo yaamod birshut hayyachid veyiftach becharmelit, becharmelit veyiftach birshut hayyachid,
b: Ella im ken asa mechitza gevoha asara tefachim, divre rabbi meir. amru lo: maase beshuk shel pattamim shehaya birushalayim, shehayu noalin umannichin et hammafteach bachallon sheal gabbe happetach. rabbi yose omer: shuk shel tzammarim haya.

Tanu rabbanan: pitche shaare ginna, bizman sheyyesh lahen bet shaar mibbifnim — poteach venoel mibbifnim, mibbachutz — poteach venoel mibbachutz, mikkan umikkan — poteach venoel kan vechan. en lahen lo lechan velo lechan — asurin kan vechan.
Vechen chanuyot happetuchot lirshut harabbim, bizman shehammanul lematta measara — mevi mafteach meerev shabbat umannicho baiskuppa, lemachar poteach venoel umachziro laiskuppa.
Uvizman shehammanul lemala measara — mevi mafteach meerev shabbat umannicho bammanul, lemachar poteach venoel umachziro limkomo, divre rabbi meir.
Vachachamim omrim: af bizman shehammanul lemala measara tefachim — mevi mafteach meerev shabbat, umannicho baiskuppa, lemachar poteach venoel umachziro limkomo, o bachallon sheal gabbe happetach.
Im yesh bachallon arbaa al arbaa — asur, mippene shehu kemotzi mershut lirshut.
