Middekaamar: "vechen chanuyot", mikkelal diviskuppat karmelit askinan. hay manul hechi dame? i delet beh arbaa, mekom petur hu.

Vei it beh arbaa, beha lema rabbanan: af bizman shehammanul lemala measara mevi mafteach meerev shabbat umannicho baiskuppa, lemachar poteach venoel bo umachziro laiskuppa o lachallon sheal gabbe happetach? veha ka metaltel mikkarmelit lirshut hayyachid!
Amar abbaye: leolam deen bo arbaa, veyesh bo lachok ulehashlimo learbaa.
Uveha peligi: derabbi meir savar chokkin lehashelim. verabbanan savri: en chokkin lehashelim.
Amar rav bivi bar abbaye, shema minna meha matnita telat: shema minna chokkin lehashelim. ushema minna hadar beh rabbi meir mishshaare ginna.

Veshamat minna midderabbanan ita lidrav dimi, dechi ata rav dimi amar rabbi yochanan: makom sheen bo arbaa al arbaa — muttar livne reshut harabbim velivne reshut hayyachid lechattef alav, uvilvad shello yachalifu.
Mishna neger sheyyesh berosho gelostera, rabbi eliezer oser verabbi yose mattir.

Amar rabbi eliezer: maase bichneset shebbitverya shehayu nohagin bo hetter, ad shebba rabban gamliel vehazzekenim veasru lahen. rabbi yose omer: issur nahagu bo, uva rabban gamliel vehazzekenim vehittiru lahen.
Gemara benittal beigdo — kulle alma la peligi. ki peligi

a: Besheeno nittal beigdo, demar savar: kevan deyesh berosho gelostera — torat keli alav. umar savar: kevan deeno nittal beigdo — lo.
Mishna neger hannigrar — noalin bo bemikdash, aval lo bimdina.
Vehammunnach kan vechan — asur. rabbi yehuda omer: hammunnach muttar bammikdash, vehannigrar bammedina.

Gemara tanu rabbanan: ezehu neger hannigrar shennoalin bammikdash aval lo bammedina — kol shekkashur vetaluy, verosho echad maggia laaretz. rabbi yehuda omer: ze af bammedina muttar, ella ezehu neger shennoalin bammikdash aval lo bammedina — kol sheeno lo kashur velo taluy, veshomto umannicho bekeren zavit.
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: halacha kerabbi yehuda benigrar.
Amar rava: vehu shekkashur baddelet. ini?! veha rabbi tavla ikkela lemachoza, vachaza lehahu dahava tele beivra dedashsha vela amar lehu vela midde? hahu nittal beigdo hava.
Rav avya ikkela linhardea, chazyeh lehahu gavra dahava ka kater begemi. amar: den la nitrok.
Bae rabbi zera: nikmaz, mahu? amar rav yosef: may tibbee leh? la shemia leh ha detanya: nishmat — asur, nikmaz — muttar. verabbi yehuda amar: nikmaz, af al pi sheeno nishmat — asur.
Veamar rav yehuda amar shemuel: halacha kerabbi yehuda benikmaz. vetama may? amar abbaye: mishshum demechze kevone.
Bea minneh rav nechumi bar zecharya meabbaye: asa lo bet yad, mahu? amar leh: buchena kaamrat. ittemar, amar rav nechumi bar adda: asa lo bet yad — muttar.
Hahu sharita dahava be rabbi pedat dahava madlu la be asra veshadu la addesha, vela amar lehu vela midde. amar — torat keli aleha.
Hahi asita dahavat be mar shemuel dahava machzeket adribba, shera mar shemuel lemishdeyay addasha. amar — torat keli aleha.

Shelach leh rame bar yechezkel lerav amram: nema lan mar mehalen mille mealleyayta daamart lan mishshemeh derav assi bechippe dearba. shelach leh, hachi amar rav assi: hane kippe dearba bizman sheyyesh bahen tefach, i name en bahen tefach veen ben ze laze shelosha — lemachar mevi machtzelet ufores alehen.
May tama — mosif al ohel aray hu, veshappir dame.
Hanhu dichre dahavo leh lerav huna, devimama beo tulla uvelelya beo avvera. ata lekammeh derav.
Amar leh: zil keroch budeyay, veshayyayr ba tefach, limchar pashta umosif al ohel aray hu, veshappir dame.
Amar rav mishshum rabbi chiyyay: vilon muttar lintoto umuttar leforko beshabbat.
Killat chatanim muttar leforkah velintotah beshabbat. amar rav sheshet bereh derav idi: la amaran ella sheen begaggah tefach, aval yesh begaggah tefach — asur.
Vechi en begaggah tefach, la amaran ella sheen befachot mishshelosha samuch laggag tefach, aval yesh befachot mishshelosha samuch laggag tefach — asur.
Vechi en befachot mishshelosha samuch laggag tefach name, la amaran ella sheen
b: Beshippuah tefach, aval yesh beshippuah tefach — shippue ohalim keohalim damu.
Veamar rav shisha bereh derav idi: seyayna — shere. vehatanya asur! la kashya: ha — deit beh tefach, ha — delet beh tefach.
Ella meatta: sharbev biglimeh tefach, hachi name deasur?
Ella, la kashya: ha — demihaddak, ha — dela mihaddak.
Mishna machzirin tzir hattachton bammikdash, aval lo bammedina. vehaelyon — kan vechan asur. rabbi yehuda omer: haelyon — bammikdash, vehattachton — bammedina.
Gemara tanu rabbanan: tzir delet shidda teva umigdal, bammikdash — machazirin, bammedina — dochakin. vehaelyon — kan vechan lo yachazir, gezera shemma yitka. veim taka — chayyayv chattat.
Shel bor veshel dut veshel yatzia — lo yachzir, veim hechzir chayyayv chattat.
Mishna machzirin retiyya bammikdash, aval lo bammedina. im battechilla — kan vechan asur.

Gemara tanu rabbanan: retiyya sheppersha meal gabbe makka — machzirin beshabbat. rabbi yehuda omer: huchelka lematta — dochakah lemala, lemala — dochakah lematta, umegalle miktzat hartiyya umekanneach pi hammakka, vechozer umegalle miktzat retiyya umekanneach pi hammakka.
Uretiyya atzmah lo yekanneach, mippene shehu memareach. veim merach — chayyayv chattat.
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: halacha kerabbi yehuda. amar rav chisda: lo shanu ella sheppersha al gabbe keli, aval persha al gabbe karka — divre hakkol asur.

Amar mar bar rav ashe: hava kaemna kammeh abba, nefala leh abbe sadya, veka mahdar leh. amena leh: la savar la mar leha deamar rav chisda: machloket sheppersha al gabbe keli, aval persha al gabbe karka — asur, veamar shemuel: halacha kerabbi yehuda!
Amar li: la shemia li, kelomar la sevira li.
Mishna koshrin nima bammikdash, aval lo bammedina. veim battechilla — kan vechan asur.
Gemara ureminhu: nimat kinnor shennifseka — lo haya koshrah ella onvah! la kashya: ha — rabbanan, veha — rabbi eliezer.
Lerabbi eliezer deamar machshire mitzva dochin et hashshabbat, koshrah. lerabbanan deamri en dochin, onvah.
I rabbi eliezer, afillu lechattechilla name!
Ella, la kashya: ha — rabbi yehuda, veha — rabbanan.
Verabbi yehuda allibba deman?
